chapters.title: Chapter 5055: Awakening! I
paragraphs: THE Secretive Eon appeared in a domain that existed between Observable and Unobservable.

The space measured only a mile wide in diameter, a pocket of stability carved into the boundary separating what could be perceived from what could not. Beyond its edges, swirling weavings of Unobservable wrapped around the domain in configurations that would have driven lesser beings mad merely from proximity. The darkness there moved with purpose, pressing against the domain’s boundaries without quite breaching them.

Within this small sanctuary, vibrant green grasses covered the ground in carpets that should not have been possible given the forces surrounding them. A simple white hut stood at the center, its construction humble and unremarkable, the kind of dwelling that suggested meditation rather than habitation. This place had been hidden for eons, known only to one existence in all of Observable Existence.
Until now.

Behind Eon, a sliver of a gateway remained open where she had entered. From it, THE Primordial Paradox stepped through, his obsidian titanic form immediately scanning the surroundings with attention that missed nothing. His paradoxical authority rippled around him as he observed the grasses, the hut, the swirling Unobservable beyond the boundaries.
"This place I have not been to."
His voice emerged with the weight of someone realizing they had been deceived.
"Just what more are you hiding?"
THE Secretive Eon did not respond immediately.

She sat down upon the vibrant grasses with calm that seemed inappropriate. Her expression held resignation rather than fear, acceptance rather than anxiety. Whatever she was about to do, she had made peace with it long before this moment arrived.
Then she plunged her hand into her own chest.

Her fingers passed through flesh that parted without resistance, reaching into depths where her foundations resided. When she withdrew her hand, she held a key that blazed with golden light so pure it seemed to reject the surrounding Unobservable entirely. The key was ornate and ancient, its design suggesting purposes that predated most classifications Observable Existence currently employed.
Eon parted the hair behind her neck, exposing skin that had not seen light in eons.
Without looking at THE Primordial Paradox, she extended the key toward him.
"I wish I had never told you about me."
Her voice emerged flat and tired.
"I wanted to never return to that state. Even when I was being controlled by Unity, I did not reach out to it. I wanted to overcome it myself."
She paused.

"But I failed. Osmont scorched Unity out of me, and in turn, he has also loosened the seal. Since it will break regardless, I will consider this eons-long experiment to have been a failure. I thought I could make things happen without it, but whatever."
She thrust the key toward him more insistently.
"Take the key. I made it so that I could not fully unlock it myself."
THE Primordial Paradox grasped the key with confusion visible across his obsidian features.
"What are you talking about? I reached out to you because of your Civilization. With it, my Paradox can undergo acceleration even-"
"I lied to you about my Civilization."
Her interruption was sharp and final.
"Just put the key on the back of my neck. Everything will become clearer after."
THE Secretive Eon wore a hardened expression as she spoke these words.

A key. Something even THE Primordial Mycelia had never sensed during its occupation of her existence, something far above that fungal horror’s stature to perceive. Naturally, a key meant something was locked. And right now, that something was Eon herself.
Turning the key would unlock her.

Doing so was an admission that she had failed, that her experiment in living as something lesser had concluded in defeat. What could she do? Existence was unfair. It had always been unfair. She had simply spent eons pretending otherwise.
Behind her, THE Primordial Paradox continued to frown as he brought the key toward her exposed neck.
"I may speak to you differently and change afterward."
Her voice held hesitation for the first time.
"Do not mind it. I will still be me. Just somewhat different."

THE Primordial Paradox frowned even more deeply at her words. He shook his head at the strangeness of this situation, at the mysteries piling upon mysteries, at the sense that he was about to participate in something he did not understand.
Then he plunged the key into her neck.

The golden metal entered her flesh with blinding light that pressed against his perception. The key sank deeper than should have been possible, finding a lock that existed somewhere beyond physical form.
CLICK!
He turned the key.
And...
BOOM!

THE Primordial Paradox found his body flung across the domain before he could process what had occurred. He smashed against the boundaries where Observable met Unobservable, the collision sending shockwaves through his obsidian form. When he managed to orient himself and look back toward where Eon had been sitting...
He observed something magisterial!
All around the domain, golden misty light gathered with speed and density that defied comprehension.

The force of Observable itself was flooding into this small space, drawn by something that demanded its presence. Rivers of golden luminosity poured toward the figure of Eon from every direction, converging upon her form with intensity that painted the entire domain in hues of captured sunlight.
Her aura became something else entirely.
THE Primordial Paradox attempted to rise from where he had landed, pushing against the ground with strength that had conquered countless enemies across eons of conflict.
His body refused to comply. Something pressed down upon him with force that would not permit him to stand, as if all of surrounding existence had to remain low for what was waking up.
He could only watch from his position near the ground.

Golden rivers of Observable force continued flowing into Eon as she rose from the grasses without apparent effort. The power lifted her upward, rivers of golden light forming beneath her feet to create platforms of solidified authority. Her dark hair shone with brilliance that seemed to generate its own illumination rather than reflecting what surrounded her. Her eyes, when she opened them, radiated endless gold that pressed against THE Primordial Paradox’s perception with intensity.
The force she radiated horrified him.

It seemed to exceed the Singular Cognizance he had faced when fighting alongside Erwin. It surpassed what he had believed possible for any being at THE First Scale. It defied everything he understood about the hierarchy of power!
"What... is this?"
He had to ask the question even though speaking required effort against the pressure pinning him down.
Eon turned to look at him.
Her body had transformed. An unfathomable sense of beauty now permeated her existence, the kind that made observation feel like privilege rather than simple perception.
Radiant golden tattoos rolled from her neck down to her chest. Upon her wrists, golden bands shining with contained authority had formed, their presence suggesting royalty rather than ornamentation.
Her expression had changed as well.

Where before there had been coldness and calm, now there was coldness born of supremacy. Where before there had been calculation, now there was the calm of one who did not need to calculate because outcomes were predetermined in her favor.
Arrogance radiated from her bearing!
She replied to THE Primordial Paradox with a voice that sounded glorious and detached, as if she were addressing someone beneath her rather than an equal.
"What this is, is my whims coming to an end."
The golden rivers continued flowing into her as she spoke.
"I admit I do not have the power to do anything without what I was born with. You...will be rewarded for aiding me in my transition."

When she withdrew her hand, she held a key that blazed with golden light so pure it seemed to reject the surrounding Unobservable entirely.
The key was ornate and ancient, its design suggesting purposes that predated most classifications Observable Existence currently employed.
Eon parted the hair behind her neck, exposing skin that had not seen light in eons.
Without looking at THE Primordial Paradox, she extended the key toward him.
"I wish I had never told you about me."
Her voice emerged flat and tired.
"I wanted to never return to that state.
Even when I was being controlled by Unity, I did not reach out to it.
I wanted to overcome it myself."
She paused.
"But I failed.
Osmont scorched Unity out of me, and in turn, he has also loosened the seal.
Since it will break regardless, I will consider this eons-long experiment to have been a failure.
I thought I could make things happen without it, but whatever."
She thrust the key toward him more insistently.
"Take the key.
I made it so that I could not fully unlock it myself."
THE Primordial Paradox grasped the key with confusion visible across his obsidian features.
"What are you talking about?
I reached out to you because of your Civilization.
With it, my Paradox can undergo acceleration even-"
"I lied to you about my Civilization."
Her interruption was sharp and final.
"Just put the key on the back of my neck.
Everything will become clearer after."
THE Secretive Eon wore a hardened expression as she spoke these words.
A key.
Something even THE Primordial Mycelia had never sensed during its occupation of her existence, something far above that fungal horror’s stature to perceive.
Naturally, a key meant something was locked.
And right now, that something was Eon herself.
Turning the key would unlock her.
Doing so was an admission that she had failed, that her experiment in living as something lesser had concluded in defeat.
What could she do?
Existence was unfair.
It had always been unfair.
She had simply spent eons pretending otherwise.
Behind her, THE Primordial Paradox continued to frown as he brought the key toward her exposed neck.
"I may speak to you differently and change afterward."
Her voice held hesitation for the first time.
"Do not mind it.
I will still be me.
Just somewhat different."
THE Primordial Paradox frowned even more deeply at her words.
He shook his head at the strangeness of this situation, at the mysteries piling upon mysteries, at the sense that he was about to participate in something he did not understand.
Then he plunged the key into her neck.
The golden metal entered her flesh with blinding light that pressed against his perception.
The key sank deeper than should have been possible, finding a lock that existed somewhere beyond physical form.
CLICK!
He turned the key.
And...
BOOM!
THE Primordial Paradox found his body flung across the domain before he could process what had occurred.
He smashed against the boundaries where Observable met Unobservable, the collision sending shockwaves through his obsidian form.
When he managed to orient himself and look back toward where Eon had been sitting...
He observed something magisterial!
All around the domain, golden misty light gathered with speed and density that defied comprehension.
The force of Observable itself was flooding into this small space, drawn by something that demanded its presence.
Rivers of golden luminosity poured toward the figure of Eon from every direction, converging upon her form with intensity that painted the entire domain in hues of captured sunlight.
Her aura became something else entirely.
THE Primordial Paradox attempted to rise from where he had landed, pushing against the ground with strength that had conquered countless enemies across eons of conflict.
His body refused to comply.
Something pressed down upon him with force that would not permit him to stand, as if all of surrounding existence had to remain low for what was waking up.
He could only watch from his position near the ground.
Golden rivers of Observable force continued flowing into Eon as she rose from the grasses without apparent effort.
The power lifted her upward, rivers of golden light forming beneath her feet to create platforms of solidified authority.
Her dark hair shone with brilliance that seemed to generate its own illumination rather than reflecting what surrounded her.
Her eyes, when she opened them, radiated endless gold that pressed against THE Primordial Paradox’s perception with intensity.
The force she radiated horrified him.
It seemed to exceed the Singular Cognizance he had faced when fighting alongside Erwin.
It surpassed what he had believed possible for any being at THE First Scale.
It defied everything he understood about the hierarchy of power!
"What... is this?"
He had to ask the question even though speaking required effort against the pressure pinning him down.
Eon turned to look at him.
Her body had transformed.
An unfathomable sense of beauty now permeated her existence, the kind that made observation feel like privilege rather than simple perception.
Radiant golden tattoos rolled from her neck down to her chest.
Upon her wrists, golden bands shining with contained authority had formed, their presence suggesting royalty rather than ornamentation.
Her expression had changed as well.
Where before there had been coldness and calm, now there was coldness born of supremacy.
Where before there had been calculation, now there was the calm of one who did not need to calculate because outcomes were predetermined in her favor.
Arrogance radiated from her bearing!
She replied to THE Primordial Paradox with a voice that sounded glorious and detached, as if she were addressing someone beneath her rather than an equal.
"What this is, is my whims coming to an end."
The golden rivers continued flowing into her as she spoke.
"I admit I do not have the power to do anything without what I was born with.
You...will be rewarded for aiding me in my transition."

chapters.title: Chapter 5056: Awakening! II
paragraphs: THE Primordial Paradox frowned at her tone, at the implicit dismissal contained within her words. He sought to rise again, gathering his Civilization of Paradox around him in preparation to force himself upward through whatever pressure held him down.
Eon simply waved her hand.
The pressure vanished, and he was able to stand.

His expression remained heavy as he observed her, still seeing boundless golden swirling misty light flowing into her form from every direction. The Observable force showed no signs of diminishing. If anything, it was accelerating, more rivers converging upon her with each passing moment.
"I really need you to explain now."
His voice emerged somber and demanding.
"Why do you feel even stronger than a Singular Cognizance at THE Second Scale when you should only be at THE First Scale?"

THE Secretive Eon turned to look at him with calm and imperious bearing. She placed her hands upon her chest as if sensing her own existence, feeling the changes that the unlocking had wrought within her foundations.
"Because you and I are distinctly different."
Her words carried no apology.

"I was born made different. I tried to live like you and all others, and I failed. Because lifeforms like you, what I tried to be, do not have the capacity to influence Existence to a high enough level."
She paused, her golden eyes studying him with assessment that felt clinical.
"That part of myself has admitted this after falling prey to a fucking fungus and having to be saved by another. Which brings another problem because..."
Eon looked deeper into her existence as she spoke, her attention turning inward.

There, nestled within her foundations, she sensed something that made her frown. An irreversible and unbreakable bond with Quintessence Infiniforce existed within her, something that Osmont had placed in her eons ago in Ginnungagap. Her old self had not known about it. The connection had been subtle, hidden beneath layers of her diminished existence where her sealed perceptions could not reach.

It had entrenched itself into her existence so thoroughly that as she examined it now, she understood she could not expel it. The thing held Infinity within it, and Infinity was not something that could be removed through force alone.
Worse, this Quintessence Infiniforce was actually benefiting from her nature. She could sense her weavings, her authority, her Observable force flowing into the connection.
This would be a problem.
As she frowned at this discovery, THE Primordial Paradox maintained his heavy gaze upon her. He shook his head at answers that only generated more questions.
"What does that mean? What are you, really?"
His voice demanded truth rather than requesting it.
THE Secretive Eon turned to face him with calm that bordered on indifference.
"To understand what I am is to understand what you are."
Her golden eyes held no warmth.
"In Existence, all beings are not born equal. You are among THE Bounded Lifeforms. You and countless others. I am what is known as THE Gilded Lifeform. A different pedigree of lifeform entirely."
She let those words settle before continuing.
"My former self lied to you about my Civilization. My Civilization... is anything I wish among that which is Observable."
BOOM!

As she spoke these final words, she waved her hands to feel the heavy concentrated golden misty light of Observable continuing to flood into her form. The force responded to her gesture, swirling around her fingers as if eager to serve. She looked toward THE Primordial Paradox, who observed all of this with grim expression that could not hide his growing unease.
Eon shook her head at his obvious confusion.
"You required help with your Anchor? Sure. Here you go."
HUUM!
As she spoke, she tapped out with casual gesture that should not have been capable of accomplishing anything significant.

From the boundless power of Observable surrounding her, a blazing golden light began to form. It coalesced into configurations that THE Primordial Paradox recognized immediately, patterns that he had spent eons preparing to forge through careful affirmation and absolute self-knowledge.
A singularity of Paradox, perfect and complete, materialized from the force of Observable.

It entered into THE Primordial Paradox before he could react, flooding his foundations alongside an influx of Observable force that saturated every aspect of his existence. He had not called out any affirmations. He had not established his identity through the declarations that Civilizational Anchors required. He had not done anything except stand there and watch.
Yet an instant later...
BOOM!
A terrifying aura of power emanated from THE Primordial Paradox as shock overwhelmed his features.

A glorious Civilizational Anchor had formed within him without his participation. It felt just as powerful if not more powerful than what he would have forged himself through eons of careful preparation. The foundation of his transition to THE Proterozoic Scale now existed within his foundations, placed there by someone who had treated the process as casual generosity.
Before he could process what had just occurred, Eon looked at him with even greater calm.
"Have your Proterozoic Scale entry as well."
HUUM!

With such words, the tattoos adorning her body shone with brilliance that pressed against perception. Even more golden misty light flooded into THE Primordial Paradox, most of it flowing into his chest where his bones resided. The force pressed into his skeletal structure with intensity that would have destroyed any existence not prepared to receive it.
An aura of a Proterozoic Scale entity began radiating from his form.

His chest bones continued absorbing the golden misty light, transforming through processes that should have required years of careful cultivation. The Observable force was remaking him, elevating him, forcing advancement that he had not earned through any methodology he understood.
While all of this happened, he looked at Eon with incredulity that could not be contained.
"Hey. What the fuck is this?!"
His voice emerged with bewilderment that stripped away all composure.
THE Secretive Eon looked back at him with calm that bordered on boredom.
"A difference in Existence."
Her golden eyes held no sympathy for his confusion.
"I told you, not all beings are born equal. You and I are not born equal. You can understand it as a feat of Existential Engineering, but even that is not entirely true."
She waved her hand dismissively.

"No matter. Acclimate to your power and do not ask too much. I have to understand how the actions of my former self may have tainted me, because now I have a parasite of Infinity latched onto my existence."

She said this coolly before turning her attention inward, beginning to study the Quintessence Infiniforce that had entrenched itself within her foundations. The golden rivers continued flowing into her form, but her attention had already moved past THE Primordial Paradox and his questions.
He stood there stupefied, power he had not earned surging through foundations that barely understood what they had received.
What the fuck were THE Gilded?
Why was he and all others deemed THE Bounded?
Did that Designation apply to everyone he had ever known? To THE Creature? To Abaddon? To Erwin? To Osmont himself?
The questions multiplied within his awareness, each one more disturbing than the last.
THE Secretive Eon continued studying the Quintessence Infiniforce within her, paying him no further attention.
He was beneath her notice now as...perhaps he had always been.

chapters.title: Chapter 5057: For All To See! I
paragraphs: In THE Wastes, seas of multicolored brilliance swirled below while rivers surged above.

The figure of Beowulf floated within this transformed landscape, his massive hammer resting against one armored shoulder as he gazed out at the area where the illusory visage of THE Creature had been displayed. That image had faded now, but its implications remained. Horus was dead. THE Creature had claimed victory and displayed the proof for all of Observable Existence to witness!
The death was a heavy one, and it made Beowulf think about many things.

He had known Horus for eons. Now that ancient Primordial Architect was simply gone, his Eyes ripped from existence and held aloft like trophies by someone who had decided the time for tolerance had ended.
At such a time, something shifted behind him.

From the seas of multicolored Infinity at his back, singularities sparked and churned with activity that should not have been possible without his awareness. The waters of the Pluvial Epoch twisted into configurations that bent space, forming pathways where none had existed moments before. Authority pressed through those pathways with intention that announced arrival rather than requested permission.
Two figures emerged from the churning brilliance.

Noah stood at the forefront, his multicolored emperor’s robe flowing with currents of Infinity that wrapped around his form like loyal serpents. Alexander stood beside him, his green robes pristine and his Enneagram rotating upon his chest with steady determination. Both of them gazed forward with expressions cold and grand, as if they had come to this place specifically to challenge what awaited them.
The massive armored figure of Beowulf turned around to observe them in stupor.

Two First Scale entities had appeared before a Second Scale existence, and they bore themselves as if the difference in power meant nothing. Their postures held no deference. Their eyes held no fear. They floated before him with the bearing of challengers rather than prey, as if this confrontation was something they had chosen rather than something they would suffer!
Noah gazed at the massive visage of Beowulf as the Primordial Architect completed his turn.

When he looked at this being now, he did not feel that heavy sense of oppression that had pressed against him during their previous encounters. His foundations had changed. His capabilities had evolved. THE Hadean Organ of Civilization pulsed within his chest with authority that declared itself ready for whatever came next.
Beside him, Alexander wore an expression of extreme coldness.

He looked at Beowulf as if he was already dismantling the armored figure piece by piece, as if this confrontation was merely formality before the violence he had been anticipating since his torture concluded. His hands remained still at his sides, but the authority gathering around him suggested those hands would not remain idle for long.
Noah nodded to Beowulf.
"Big guy, did you miss us? I did not want to make you wait for too long, so I came to fulfill my oath."

He had told this contemptible existence that he would return and pay things back manifold. That time was now here. The words emerged with confidence that pressed against the transformed landscape of THE Wastes!
Beowulf looked at them with expression that bordered on skepticism.

His armored head turned slightly, scanning the surrounding area as if searching for hidden allies or concealed traps. When he found nothing except the two beings floating before him, his twisted smile formed across features that had intimidated countless existences across eons of conflict.
"You...are arguably one of the most unique existences I have come across in a while."
His voice emerged with amusement that did not quite conceal his wariness.
Noah’s response came immediately.
"And you are one of the more boring ones. Did you see your friend, Horus, and the humiliation of his corpse displayed for all to see across Existence?"
He spoke such words grandly, letting them hang in the air between them.

Beowulf’s expression shifted into a frown that darkened his armored features. His hammer rose over his shoulders, the weapon’s presence alone causing the surroundings to begin trembling and shaking. Authority gathered around his form with intensity.
"Existence is vast and filled with wonders."
His voice emerged cold.
"Some of us will die. Some of us will triumph. With you coming here now, I will not allow you to slip away again. I will never have to experience the same fate as Horus."
His armored head tilted slightly.
"Once I grasp your weavings and secrets regarding Infinity..."
The sentence trailed off as his brutal smile returned.
"Hmmm."

Proterozoic Scale power spread outward from his form, sifting through the transformed landscape with authority that demanded submission from everything it touched. All churning rivers of multicolored brilliance around them ceased their movement. The flowing seas below became still. For the surrounding light years, everything that had been in motion simply stopped.
Even the rain falling from above halted in place, droplets of the Pluvial Epoch suspended in air that no longer permitted their descent.
Noah gave a light nod at this display of power.
"Seeing the actions of THE Creature reminded me that when it comes to truly breaking down one’s enemies and letting others know how to act, seeing is better than believing."
His eyes shone with purpose.
He raised his hand and clenched it.

The multicolored seas of Infinity shook in response to his gesture. Around them, massive disturbances churned through the transformed waters as something vast began to rise from the depths. Three illusory screens emerged from the brilliance, each one a single light year in diameter, their surfaces displaying images that captured everything occurring in this space.
The screens showed the figure of Beowulf and their figures with clarity that missed no detail.
"My weavings of Infinity are spread all across Observable Existence."
Noah’s voice carried across the light years his screens encompassed.

"Just like THE Creature was able to illuminate the fate of Horus, I will go a step further to illuminate and illustrate. I will give all of Observable Existence the chance to see the fates of those poor enough to come after me."
The illusory screens shone with brilliance that exceeded their already massive presence.
What they displayed began to permeate across Observable Existence.

Across THE Wastes, screens rose from seas and rivers of transformed brilliance. In Primordial Realms scattered throughout existence, similar displays emerged from wherever Infinity had touched. Within remaining shelters of THE Loom, screens materialized before beings who had thought themselves hidden and protected!
In Prima Indifferentia, illusory images pressed through barriers that should have been impenetrable! The Wandering Territories! The Lands of The Dead!
In all places where Infinity sensed Absolutes or any glimmers of Second Scale Existences, these illusory screens began to rise.
They streamed everything occurring at this moment.
Noah looked up as the illusory screens zoomed upon his face, Alexander visible behind him.
Multicolored Infinities wrapped around his body in rivers of endless authority. His multicolored emperor’s robe shone gloriously!
While looking into the screen, he spoke words meant for all of Observable Existence.
"Let this be a lesson and warning to all."
HUUM!

He said for this to be a warning, but he knew many would not take it like so. He knew many would take it as a challenge, which would in turn...invite Adversity. And that...was also another goal of his!
Beowulf observed this display as his gaze became unfathomably cold.
His massive body was reflected on the screens surrounding them, his armored form towering over Noah and Alexander like a giant observing ants!
His pride as an existence so much grander than them buzzed with indignation at this moment, at being made a spectacle for beings across Observable Existence to witness!
"I will not stop at dissecting your existence. I will-"
At such a time, Noah’s words interrupted him.
"Hold on."
Because at this moment, Noah began to feel something horrific and grand inside his existence.

A flood of the power of Observable surged from within him in an unfathomable manner, its concentration far exceeding anything he had handled before. Golden misty light erupted from his foundations with intensity that should have torn him apart. The force was vast and overwhelming, a sea of Observable power pouring through connections he had not consciously activated!
It felt surreal and utterly overwhelming.

There was so much that his existence was almost initially overwhelmed by the sheer volume of what was flooding through him. His foundations trembled under the pressure, his cells burning with golden light that pressed outward from within. Then THE Hadean Organ of Civilization began to spin right after, collecting the terrifying misty golden seas of Observable force with efficiency that prevented catastrophic overflow.
Every cell and atom within his body literally began to burn with golden light of Observable!

His existence worked rapidly to process what was occurring. Infinite Undifferentiated Fate searched for the connection to understand where this flood originated, but he could not find anything apart from the connection with THE Primordial Paradox.
When he dug deeper toward the source of these terrifying waves of Observable force, he felt as if he was being blocked by barriers that resisted his perception.
He proceeded to use the overflowing power of Observable itself to finally affirm the truth.
Particles of his Quintessence Infiniforce were acting as pathways, pulling from a source. The connection led to...Eon. THE Secretive Eon!
What...
"Are you okay?"
Beside him, Alexander asked the question as Noah appeared to have frozen in place, his eyes burning with golden light while his expression shifted through confusion and calculation.
As Noah was in the middle of ascertaining all this, Beowulf became cold and apathetic.
The Primordial Architect raised his hammer. His armored features showed no amusement now, no fucking tolerance for whatever his opponents were experiencing!
He had been interrupted, insulted, and made into a spectacle for all of Observable Existence to witness.
"No playing around this time."
His voice emerged with frost that spread across the suspended droplets around them.
"I will collapse you and look at the pieces after. Let me show you how vast the gulf is between THE Second Scale and THE First Scale."
HUUM!
As he said this, he swung his hammer.

Noah’s eyes could see the backbone and makeup of that weapon as it descended toward him and Alexander. Within the hammer’s construction, a single shining crimson obsidian bone blazed with light that pressed against perception.
A Proterozoic Bone, fully activated, channeling the full might of a Second Scale existence through an instrument designed specifically for destruction.
The hammer thundered down toward them!
Time seemed to slow as Noah processed what was occurring. The flood of Observable force continued burning through his foundations. The hammer continued its descent.

Alexander stood beside him, ready to fight but lacking the capability to stop what was coming. The illusory screens broadcast everything to Observable Existence, capturing the moment when THE Youngest would be crushed by power he should not have challenged!
Noah put his hand on his chest.

His fingers pressed through his emperor’s robe, reaching toward the Organ of Civilization that spun with fury within him. From that Organ, he pulled forth a weapon that should not have existed at THE First Scale.
THE Hadean Spear of Civilization emerged from his sternum.
The multicolored crystalline Kontos spear materialized into his grip as the hammer continued its descent!

Around his body, the vibrant lights of Observable and Unobservable began swirling with intensity that exceeded anything he had previously channeled. Golden mist and clear smoke wound around his form, both forces converging upon the tip of his spear with concentration that made the air itself tremble.
The tip of the spear rose to meet the giant hammer!
And...
CRACK!
The impact was shocking and forceful and blinding!
A horrid sound echoed across existence as Proterozoic Bone met Civilizational Armament, as THE Second Scale collided with something that should not have been possible at THE First Scale.
Light erupted from the point of contact with brilliance that painted the suspended droplets of rain with hues existence rarely witnessed.
Noah remained floating exactly where he was.
He did not move. He did not budge. He did not shift a single inch from the position he had occupied before the hammer’s descent.
Instead, the massive hammer of Beowulf was knocked backward and upward.
Oh!
The weapon that had crushed an unknown number of existences across eons of conflict recoiled from the collision, its Proterozoic Bone ringing with frequencies!
Beowulf’s armored arms absorbed the recoil, his massive form pushed back by a force that should not have come from a First Scale being.
Stupor and astonishment followed.
Noah stood there in the aftermath, his spear held at angle.

The light of Quintessence Infiniforce blazed around him in rivers of multicolored brilliance. Infinity wrapped around his form, and Unobservable and Observable forces swirled around his weapon in clear and golden rivers that pressed against everything they touched.
He held that spear!
THAT Spear!
THE Hadean Spear of Civilization!
The illusory screens captured everything.

They broadcast his image across Observable Existence, showing countless beings the moment when THE Genesis Monarch blocked the full strike of a Proterozoic Scale entity and knocked that strike away without moving from his position.
Noah pulled the spear back and spoke with a frown.
"I told you to hold on. Sit the fuck back for a second."
Oh!
OH!
Even Alexander looked at Noah in stupor!
Beowulf stared at his hammer and then at Noah’s spear.
His gaze moved between the two weapons back and forth!
The body of this Primordial Architect then began to vibrate and shake with rage!

The figure of Beowulf floated within this transformed landscape, his massive hammer resting against one armored shoulder as he gazed out at the area where the illusory visage of THE Creature had been displayed.
That image had faded now, but its implications remained.
Horus was dead.
THE Creature had claimed victory and displayed the proof for all of Observable Existence to witness!
The death was a heavy one, and it made Beowulf think about many things.
He had known Horus for eons.
Now that ancient Primordial Architect was simply gone, his Eyes ripped from existence and held aloft like trophies by someone who had decided the time for tolerance had ended.
At such a time, something shifted behind him.
From the seas of multicolored Infinity at his back, singularities sparked and churned with activity that should not have been possible without his awareness.
The waters of the Pluvial Epoch twisted into configurations that bent space, forming pathways where none had existed moments before.
Authority pressed through those pathways with intention that announced arrival rather than requested permission.
Two figures emerged from the churning brilliance.
Noah stood at the forefront, his multicolored emperor’s robe flowing with currents of Infinity that wrapped around his form like loyal serpents.
Alexander stood beside him, his green robes pristine and his Enneagram rotating upon his chest with steady determination.
Both of them gazed forward with expressions cold and grand, as if they had come to this place specifically to challenge what awaited them.
The massive armored figure of Beowulf turned around to observe them in stupor.
Two First Scale entities had appeared before a Second Scale existence, and they bore themselves as if the difference in power meant nothing.
Their postures held no deference.
Their eyes held no fear.
They floated before him with the bearing of challengers rather than prey, as if this confrontation was something they had chosen rather than something they would suffer!
Noah gazed at the massive visage of Beowulf as the Primordial Architect completed his turn.
When he looked at this being now, he did not feel that heavy sense of oppression that had pressed against him during their previous encounters.
His foundations had changed.
His capabilities had evolved.
THE Hadean Organ of Civilization pulsed within his chest with authority that declared itself ready for whatever came next.
Beside him, Alexander wore an expression of extreme coldness.

He looked at Beowulf as if he was already dismantling the armored figure piece by piece, as if this confrontation was merely formality before the violence he had been anticipating since his torture concluded.
His hands remained still at his sides, but the authority gathering around him suggested those hands would not remain idle for long.
Noah nodded to Beowulf.
"Big guy, did you miss us?
I did not want to make you wait for too long, so I came to fulfill my oath."
He had told this contemptible existence that he would return and pay things back manifold.
That time was now here.
The words emerged with confidence that pressed against the transformed landscape of THE Wastes!
Beowulf looked at them with expression that bordered on skepticism.
His armored head turned slightly, scanning the surrounding area as if searching for hidden allies or concealed traps.
When he found nothing except the two beings floating before him, his twisted smile formed across features that had intimidated countless existences across eons of conflict.
"You...are arguably one of the most unique existences I have come across in a while."
His voice emerged with amusement that did not quite conceal his wariness.
Noah’s response came immediately.
"And you are one of the more boring ones.
Did you see your friend, Horus, and the humiliation of his corpse displayed for all to see across Existence?"
He spoke such words grandly, letting them hang in the air between them.
Beowulf’s expression shifted into a frown that darkened his armored features.
His hammer rose over his shoulders, the weapon’s presence alone causing the surroundings to begin trembling and shaking.
Authority gathered around his form with intensity.
"Existence is vast and filled with wonders."
His voice emerged cold.
"Some of us will die.
Some of us will triumph.
With you coming here now, I will not allow you to slip away again.
I will never have to experience the same fate as Horus."
His armored head tilted slightly.
"Once I grasp your weavings and secrets regarding Infinity..."
The sentence trailed off as his brutal smile returned.
"Hmmm."
Proterozoic Scale power spread outward from his form, sifting through the transformed landscape with authority that demanded submission from everything it touched.
All churning rivers of multicolored brilliance around them ceased their movement.
The flowing seas below became still.
For the surrounding light years, everything that had been in motion simply stopped.
Even the rain falling from above halted in place, droplets of the Pluvial Epoch suspended in air that no longer permitted their descent.
Noah gave a light nod at this display of power.
"Seeing the actions of THE Creature reminded me that when it comes to truly breaking down one’s enemies and letting others know how to act, seeing is better than believing."
His eyes shone with purpose.
He raised his hand and clenched it.
The multicolored seas of Infinity shook in response to his gesture.
Around them, massive disturbances churned through the transformed waters as something vast began to rise from the depths.
Three illusory screens emerged from the brilliance, each one a single light year in diameter, their surfaces displaying images that captured everything occurring in this space.
The screens showed the figure of Beowulf and their figures with clarity that missed no detail.
"My weavings of Infinity are spread all across Observable Existence."
Noah’s voice carried across the light years his screens encompassed.
"Just like THE Creature was able to illuminate the fate of Horus, I will go a step further to illuminate and illustrate.
I will give all of Observable Existence the chance to see the fates of those poor enough to come after me."
The illusory screens shone with brilliance that exceeded their already massive presence.
What they displayed began to permeate across Observable Existence.
Across THE Wastes, screens rose from seas and rivers of transformed brilliance.
In Primordial Realms scattered throughout existence, similar displays emerged from wherever Infinity had touched.
Within remaining shelters of THE Loom, screens materialized before beings who had thought themselves hidden and protected!
In Prima Indifferentia, illusory images pressed through barriers that should have been impenetrable!
The Wandering Territories!
The Lands of The Dead!
In all places where Infinity sensed Absolutes or any glimmers of Second Scale Existences, these illusory screens began to rise.
They streamed everything occurring at this moment.
Noah looked up as the illusory screens zoomed upon his face, Alexander visible behind him.
Multicolored Infinities wrapped around his body in rivers of endless authority.
His multicolored emperor’s robe shone gloriously!
While looking into the screen, he spoke words meant for all of Observable Existence.
"Let this be a lesson and warning to all."
HUUM!
He said for this to be a warning, but he knew many would not take it like so.
He knew many would take it as a challenge, which would in turn...invite Adversity.
And that...was also another goal of his!
Beowulf observed this display as his gaze became unfathomably cold.
His massive body was reflected on the screens surrounding them, his armored form towering over Noah and Alexander like a giant observing ants!
His pride as an existence so much grander than them buzzed with indignation at this moment, at being made a spectacle for beings across Observable Existence to witness!
"I will not stop at dissecting your existence.
I will-"
At such a time, Noah’s words interrupted him.
"Hold on."
Because at this moment, Noah began to feel something horrific and grand inside his existence.
A flood of the power of Observable surged from within him in an unfathomable manner, its concentration far exceeding anything he had handled before.
Golden misty light erupted from his foundations with intensity that should have torn him apart.
The force was vast and overwhelming, a sea of Observable power pouring through connections he had not consciously activated!
It felt surreal and utterly overwhelming.
There was so much that his existence was almost initially overwhelmed by the sheer volume of what was flooding through him.
His foundations trembled under the pressure, his cells burning with golden light that pressed outward from within.
Then THE Hadean Organ of Civilization began to spin right after, collecting the terrifying misty golden seas of Observable force with efficiency that prevented catastrophic overflow.
Every cell and atom within his body literally began to burn with golden light of Observable!
His existence worked rapidly to process what was occurring.
Infinite Undifferentiated Fate searched for the connection to understand where this flood originated, but he could not find anything apart from the connection with THE Primordial Paradox.
When he dug deeper toward the source of these terrifying waves of Observable force, he felt as if he was being blocked by barriers that resisted his perception.
He proceeded to use the overflowing power of Observable itself to finally affirm the truth.
Particles of his Quintessence Infiniforce were acting as pathways, pulling from a source.
The connection led to...Eon.
THE Secretive Eon!
What...
"Are you okay?"
Beside him, Alexander asked the question as Noah appeared to have frozen in place, his eyes burning with golden light while his expression shifted through confusion and calculation.
As Noah was in the middle of ascertaining all this, Beowulf became cold and apathetic.
The Primordial Architect raised his hammer.
His armored features showed no amusement now, no fucking tolerance for whatever his opponents were experiencing!
He had been interrupted, insulted, and made into a spectacle for all of Observable Existence to witness.
"No playing around this time."
His voice emerged with frost that spread across the suspended droplets around them.
"I will collapse you and look at the pieces after.
Let me show you how vast the gulf is between THE Second Scale and THE First Scale."
HUUM!
As he said this, he swung his hammer.
Noah’s eyes could see the backbone and makeup of that weapon as it descended toward him and Alexander.
Within the hammer’s construction, a single shining crimson obsidian bone blazed with light that pressed against perception.
A Proterozoic Bone, fully activated, channeling the full might of a Second Scale existence through an instrument designed specifically for destruction.
The hammer thundered down toward them!
Time seemed to slow as Noah processed what was occurring.
The flood of Observable force continued burning through his foundations.
The hammer continued its descent.
Alexander stood beside him, ready to fight but lacking the capability to stop what was coming.
The illusory screens broadcast everything to Observable Existence, capturing the moment when THE Youngest would be crushed by power he should not have challenged!
Noah put his hand on his chest.
His fingers pressed through his emperor’s robe, reaching toward the Organ of Civilization that spun with fury within him.
From that Organ, he pulled forth a weapon that should not have existed at THE First Scale.
THE Hadean Spear of Civilization emerged from his sternum.
The multicolored crystalline Kontos spear materialized into his grip as the hammer continued its descent!
Around his body, the vibrant lights of Observable and Unobservable began swirling with intensity that exceeded anything he had previously channeled.
Golden mist and clear smoke wound around his form, both forces converging upon the tip of his spear with concentration that made the air itself tremble.
The tip of the spear rose to meet the giant hammer!
And...
CRACK!
The impact was shocking and forceful and blinding!
A horrid sound echoed across existence as Proterozoic Bone met Civilizational Armament, as THE Second Scale collided with something that should not have been possible at THE First Scale.
Light erupted from the point of contact with brilliance that painted the suspended droplets of rain with hues existence rarely witnessed.
Noah remained floating exactly where he was.
He did not move.
He did not budge.
He did not shift a single inch from the position he had occupied before the hammer’s descent.
Instead, the massive hammer of Beowulf was knocked backward and upward.
Oh!
The weapon that had crushed an unknown number of existences across eons of conflict recoiled from the collision, its Proterozoic Bone ringing with frequencies!
Beowulf’s armored arms absorbed the recoil, his massive form pushed back by a force that should not have come from a First Scale being.
Stupor and astonishment followed.
Noah stood there in the aftermath, his spear held at angle.
The light of Quintessence Infiniforce blazed around him in rivers of multicolored brilliance.
Infinity wrapped around his form, and Unobservable and Observable forces swirled around his weapon in clear and golden rivers that pressed against everything they touched.
He held that spear!
THAT Spear!
THE Hadean Spear of Civilization!
The illusory screens captured everything.

They broadcast his image across Observable Existence, showing countless beings the moment when THE Genesis Monarch blocked the full strike of a Proterozoic Scale entity and knocked that strike away without moving from his position.
Noah pulled the spear back and spoke with a frown.
"I told you to hold on.
Sit the fuck back for a second."
Oh!
OH!
Even Alexander looked at Noah in stupor!
Beowulf stared at his hammer and then at Noah’s spear.
His gaze moved between the two weapons back and forth!
The body of this Primordial Architect then began to vibrate and shake with rage!

chapters.title: Chapter 5058: For All To See! II
paragraphs: The collision echoed across Observable Existence through illusory screens that spared no detail.

Countless beings witnessed the moment when THE Hadean Spear of Civilization met the hammer of Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor. They observed the flash of light, heard the horrid sound that accompanied the impact, and watched as a First Scale entity remained unmoved while a Second Scale entity’s weapon recoiled backward.
Their interpretations varied according to their understanding!
In a distant area.

"He was holding back," declared a Primordial Architect observing from a domain within THE Wastes. "Beowulf clearly underestimated his opponent and pulled his strike at the last moment. No First Scale being could genuinely block a Proterozoic attack."
Around him were 2 more Primordial Architects who nodded in agreement, finding comfort in logic that preserved the hierarchy they understood.
An even further distance away.

"Infinity... must be responsible," theorized an Undivided One watching from Prima Indifferentia. "Perhaps that authority created some manner of defensive barrier that absorbed the impact. The spear itself could not have been responsible."
These beings sought explanations that fit within frameworks they already possessed!

THE Second Scale was supposed to be unreachable from THE First Scale. The gap between them was supposed to be absolute. If what they witnessed contradicted these assumptions, then surely they had witnessed incorrectly. Surely there was context they lacked. Surely Beowulf had been caught by surprise, had not taken the confrontation seriously, had permitted this outcome through carelessness rather than inability.
The alternative was unthinkable!
The alternative meant everything they understood about power and progression was incomplete.
Among those who had spent eons striving toward THE Proterozoic Scale without success, different reactions emerged.
In a Niflheimr...

"If he can do it, perhaps I can as well,"whispered an ancient being who had failed to form his Civilizational Anchor seventeen times across his existence. His eyes fixed upon the illusory screen with intensity that bordered on desperation. "Perhaps the gap is not as vast as we believed."
Hope bloomed in foundations that had long ago accepted limitation as permanent.
"Infinity changes everything," declared another, watching from a Primordial Realm where the Pluvial Epoch had continued transforming the landscape.

These beings observed the impact and saw possibility rather than anomaly. They did not understand what had occurred, but they understood what it might mean for their own futures. If THE First Scale could challenge THE Second Scale, then ceilings they had believed unbreakable might possess cracks they had never perceived.
Their hope was not entirely misplaced.
But it was not entirely accurate either.
Among those who had touched THE Proterozoic Scale themselves, who understood what that power actually meant, reactions were markedly different.
Smiles vanished from faces that had been amused moments before.

Expressions that had held condescension shifted into seriousness that pressed against their surroundings. Beings who had been observing casually, treating the broadcast as entertainment suddenly found themselves unable to look away.

In Prima Indifferentia, the obsidian figure with a single horn who had laughed at THE Creature’s display now observed through the same crack from which he had emerged before. His Proterozoic Bones shone with light that reflected the illusory screen’s brilliance, and his expression held none of the amusement it had contained previously.

In Jotunheim, where THE Primordial Paradox had only recently departed, the Chaos Giants carrying Abaddon’s listless body paused their procession to observe screens that rose from the transformed seas around them. THE Great Usurper, speaking through the giant whose body he had commandeered, said nothing at all as he only watched!
The truly knowledgeable did not rationalize.
They did not hope.
They understood.

Beings who had achieved THE Proterozoic Scale through their own effort, who had integrated Observable Or Unobservable forces into their Civilizations, who had forged Proterozoic Bones or Organs through methodologies spanning eons of careful cultivation, these beings recognized something in that impact that others could not perceive!
Beowulf had not held back.

His hammer had descended with the full force of a Rhyacian Proterozoic existence, channeled through a Proterozoic Bone that had been forged specifically for destruction. The crimson obsidian within that weapon had blazed with power that should have atomized any First Scale being it contacted. There had been no restraint. There had been no surprise!
There had been a genuine strike from a Second Scale entity intending to end a confrontation before it could properly begin.
And that strike had been deflected!
Not absorbed or redirected.
Deflected.

THE Youngest had met a Proterozoic attack with a weapon that should not have existed at THE First Scale, and he had knocked that attack away as if it were an inconvenience rather than an existential threat. The gap between Scales, that supposedly absolute chasm separating those who had achieved Civilizational Anchors from those who had not, had just been demonstrated to be significantly smaller than anyone had believed.
Or perhaps the gap remained exactly as vast as it had always been.
Perhaps THE Youngest simply stood in a different location than anyone had realized.
Many did not take their eyes away from the illusory screens for even a second.
They could not afford to.
Every moment of this confrontation contained information that might prove essential!
The illusory screens continued broadcasting across Observable Existence!
Beowulf was important, certainly.
But right now, Noah’s entire existence was going haywire as he felt like he had tapped into something almost as vast and grand as Infinity itself.

The force of Observable flooded his finite existence with intensity that should have torn him apart, golden light burning through every cell and atom of his form. If he did not have THE Hadean Organ of Civilization spinning within his chest, collecting and processing this influx with efficiency that prevented overflow, the result may have been disastrous.
He had locked down the source to be THE Secretive Eon.

The Quintessence Infiniforce he had placed within her eons ago in Ginnungagap was acting as a pathway, pulling Observable force from her existence into his own. He did not know why this was happening now. He did not know what had changed within Eon to trigger such a flood. But he unluckily happened to have started a battle against a Second Scale Primordial Architect, so he had to deal with both situations simultaneously.
It was extremely hard to tell a Primordial Architect to sit down and be still for a moment.
Especially when they attacked you at full power and you rebuffed their attack in front of all Observable Existence.

Noah understood this predicament intimately. He needed just a moment. Just a nanosecond or a single second to process what was occurring within his foundations, to understand the connection flooding him with power, to communicate with the source and determine what had changed. But Beowulf would not grant him that moment willingly.
So he would have to take it.

Noah observed the massive Primordial Architect far ahead of him, watching as Beowulf began to rise from the recoil of their collision. The terrifying grandeur and immensity of someone at THE Second Scale was rotating around that armored form with intensity that pressed against everything within range. His rage was visible in the vibration of his body, in the way the suspended droplets of rain around them trembled, in the cold fury radiating from features that had just experienced humiliation before all of Observable Existence.
Noah knew this fucker would not sit still.
He needed more of a push.
"You are angry? You have always been angry."
His voice emerged cold and measured.

"You hold the Civilization of Armed Existence, and yet you have remained pathetically weak. As a Primordial Architect born of THE First Scale, you barely grasped THE Second Scale by working with Horus and two others in Prima Indifferentia."
He let those words settle before continuing.
"Now Horus is dead, and you are wondering if you might be next."
Noah stared at Beowulf whose entire existence seemed to be blazing with terrifying power.

How did he know what he had said so far? How did he possess information that should have been hidden from anyone outside Beowulf’s closest confidants? Of course, it was because since he arrived here, and even slightly before, golden bubbles of loot had been leaking from Beowulf and flowing into him.
THE Hadean Existential Singularities.

He could see them with clarity. Golden bubbles of light emerged from the Primordial Architect’s armored form without that being’s awareness, drifting through the space between them with lazy purpose that belied their significance. Each bubble shone with glorious golden light, the illumination of loot that had been refined beyond simple material value into concentrated essence of another being’s existence.
They flowed toward Noah with inevitability that could not be resisted.

The bubbles disappeared into his body upon contact, their golden light absorbed by foundations hungry for what they contained. Each absorption brought weavings and information. Beowulf’s secrets, his private thoughts, his hidden shames, all of it poured into Noah through pathways the Primordial Architect could not perceive.
Prompts bloomed before his vision as the Singularities integrated.
|Hadean Existential Singularity Absorbed|
|Source: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor|
|Category: Civilizational Anchor Composition|

|Content: Subject’s Civilizational Anchor was established through affirmations declaring absolute unity between self and armament. Core affirmation recorded: "I am the weapon. The weapon is me. There is no distinction between the hand that strikes and the blow that lands. My existence is combat. My identity is war. I cannot be separated from what I wield because I am what I wield."|

|Stability Assessment: Anchor is fundamentally sound but contains vulnerability. Subject’s identity is entirely dependent on external armament. Removal or destruction of armor would cause catastrophic Anchor degradation.|
|Hadean Existential Singularity Absorbed|
|Source: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor|
|Category: Proterozoic Bone Methodology|

|Content: Subject possesses a single Proterozoic Bone integrated into his primary weapon rather than his physical form. The crimson obsidian bone within his hammer was forged through collaboration with Horus in Prima Indifferentia.|
|Hadean Existential Singularity Absorbed|
|Source: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor|
|Category: Hidden Psychological Profile|

|Content: Subject experiences profound insecurity regarding biological limitations imposed by his Civilization of Armed Existence. His complete integration with armament has rendered him incapable of physical intimacy or procreation. Subject compensates through observation of other lifeforms engaging in carnal activities, deriving vicarious satisfaction from experiences he cannot personally have.|
|Additional Content: Subject’s persistent rage stems partially from this limitation. He resents beings who possess capabilities he sacrificed for power.|
What?
What???!
Noah wanted to pause, but more information came!
|Hadean Existential Singularity Absorbed|
|Source: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor|
|Category: Alliance Intelligence|

|Content: Subject’s collaboration with Horus was not based on friendship but mutual necessity. Horus required Beowulf’s combat capabilities for territorial expansion. Beowulf required Horus’s methodology for Proterozoic advancement. With Horus eliminated, subject’s path to further advancement has been severed.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5059: What Are You? I
paragraphs: Noah read the prompts as they integrated into his awareness, each one painting a fuller picture of who Beowulf actually was beneath that intimidating armored exterior. A being who had sacrificed so much for power that he could no longer experience simple pleasures. A being whose advancement depended on others rather than his own capabilities. A being whose rage masked insecurities that would have been pathetic if they were not so dangerous.
And while Noah absorbed this information, he was weakening Beowulf without that being’s knowledge.

Every Singularity that flowed from the Primordial Architect into Noah represented something being lost. Not enough to notice immediately, perhaps not enough to notice for a while, but the extraction was occurring nonetheless. Beowulf was becoming lesser while Noah was becoming greater, and the Primordial Architect had no idea this transaction was taking place.
It would be even easier for him in this battle if he could stall for somewhat longer.
So he continued.
"Your Civilizational Anchor is fascinating, Beowulf. ’I am the weapon. The weapon is me.’ Such absolute declarations, yet they contain such obvious vulnerabilities."
Noah watched as the armored figure stiffened at words that should have been impossible for anyone outside his own existence to know.
"You did not forge your Proterozoic Bone yourself. You required Horus to provide methodology... For all your bluster about Armed Existence, you could not even arm yourself without assistance."
The rage radiating from Beowulf intensified to levels that pressed against everything within range!
"And then there is the matter of your limitations."
Noah’s voice became almost conversational in its cruelty.

"Beowulf, the grand Primordial Armor, actually feels insecure that your Civilization and nature make it so you cannot procreate or enjoy carnal pleasures. So you simply like to watch other lifeforms enjoy carnal pleasures every now and then."
He paused to let those words sink in.
"Is this part of why you are so angry? I can speak more about this and other things for all of Observable Existence to hear, or you can do what I asked and sit the fuck back for a second."
His eyes met the invisible gaze behind that armored helm.
"Can you do that? I need to check on something else first, and then we can continue."
HUUM!

His words were heavy and terrifying, declarations that should have been impossible, revelations that should have remained hidden for eternity. Behind the armored head of Beowulf, invisible eyes burned with unfathomable light of rage that pressed against the boundaries of what that form could contain.
But Beowulf raised his hammer and held it still.

He stared at Noah with menace that promised violence beyond imagination. His aura continued spreading through the surroundings, placing everything in the nearby gigaparsecs under his control, establishing dominance over the battlefield in preparation for the moment when he would no longer be constrained. His rage did not diminish. His hatred did not lessen.
But for now, he did not make a move against Noah.
Shockingly, he gave that second.
And in that second, Noah could stretch it toward Infinity.

He closed his eyes calmly as he grasped his Spear of Civilization, its crystalline shaft humming against his palm with authority that had just deflected a Proterozoic attack. He focused on his Quintessence Infiniforce, on the portions of it that continued to act as pathways for obscene amounts of Observable force flooding into his existence. He traced those pathways back toward their source, linked his existence through them, and called out.
"O Secretive Eon."
HUUM!
His voice was heavy with authority that pressed through the Quintessence Infiniforce connection.
Nothing happened for a moment.

He was about to call again when the pathways began to illuminate with golden light that eclipsed even the Observable force flowing through them. The portion of his existence he sent through those pathways was met with another presence, and they both disappeared into a single instant of Infinity.
His vision changed.

Part of his consciousness found itself moving between endless weavings of Observable, traveling through channels that existed outside normal space, passing through barriers that should have been impenetrable. The journey lasted no time at all and an eternity simultaneously, the paradox of Infinity making both statements equally true.
He appeared in a place that defied easy expectation.
|Domain Entry: Isolated Sanctuary between Observable and Unobservable.|
|Unobservable Boundary Pressure is active. All unauthorized existences experience foundational strain within this zone.|
|Immunity Triggered: Quintessence Infiniforce has granted temporary authorization.|

An illusory version of his body materialized within an isolated domain that measured only a mile in diameter. Green grass covered the ground in vibrant carpets that should not have existed given the swirling Unobservable weavings pressing against the domain’s boundaries. A simple white hut stood at the center, humble and unremarkable.
This was a sanctuary hidden between Observable and Unobservable!
Noah observed THE Primordial Paradox first.
|Entity Detected: THE Primordial Paradox.|
|Status: Frozen.|
|Current Scale: THE Proterozoic Scale - Rhyacian Tier.|
|Status Effect ’Temporal Suspension’ is active.Target cannot act, perceive, or respond until effect is lifted by source.|
Ruination became much more active with information as far too much force of Observable weavings of existence flooded him, giving him an influx of everything!
His former master stood nearby, but something was profoundly wrong with his positioning.

He appeared frozen in place, his obsidian titanic form locked in a posture. Yet his aura radiated profound power that declared his achievement of THE Second Scale with authority that could not be mistaken.
THE Primordial Paradox had achieved THE Proterozoic Scale.
And he was frozen?
Noah frowned at this impossibility before turning his attention to the one responsible.
|Entity Detected: THE Secretive Eon.|
|Status: Unknown.|
|Warning: Entity classification cannot be determined.|
THE Secretive Eon stood at the center of the domain, and the moment Noah observed her, his mind began cataloging details.
|Civilization Activation Detected: Unknown Civilization.|
|Observable Dominion is active. All Observable force within range is being redirected toward source entity.|
Her eyes radiated endless gold rather than the dark irises she had possessed.
Radiant golden tattoos rolled from her neck down to her chest in configurations that told stories in languages predating speech.
Upon her wrists, golden bands shining with contained authority had formed.
Her posture had changed entirely from what he remembered.

Where before she had carried herself with the cold calculation of someone who had experienced wonder, now she bore herself with the cold supremacy of someone who had never needed to plan anything at all. The difference was subtle but unmistakable.
Her shoulders held no tension. Her stance contained no preparation for threat. She existed in a state of absolute certainty that nothing around her could pose genuine danger.
She looked at him as a queen might look at a peasant who had wandered into her throne room.
|Observable Force Flow Analysis:|
|Direction: All vectors pointing toward THE Secretive Eon.|
|Volume: Exceeds measurable parameters.|
|Absorption Rate: 100% efficiency.|
|Conclusion: Entity is not cultivating. Entity is restoring to come previous unknown state.|
Golden misty light of Observable continued flowing into her form from every direction, rivers of force that exceeded anything he had witnessed even during his own transformations.

The volume was staggering. The concentration was beyond what should have been possible for any container to hold. Yet she absorbed it without strain, without effort, without any indication that she was doing anything remarkable at all.
Noah assembled these observations into conclusions that formed with uncomfortable clarity.
He could see the evidence of transformation.
But the fundamental question remained beyond his capacity to determine.
Noah looked at her directly, his illusory form standing before her actual presence with posture that refused to show deference regardless of what she had become.
Other questions he could infer answers to through observation and deduction.
But one question remained that he could not answer through inference alone.
"What...are you?"
His voice emerged steady and demanding, filtering no confusion, displaying no uncertainty.
Other things he could determine. But what exactly was Eon?

chapters.title: Chapter 5060: What Are You? II
paragraphs: In this moment stretched out toward an infinity, Noah looked at Eon.

She looked back at him with an expression so calm it bordered on indifference, those endless golden eyes holding none of the calculation he had grown accustomed to seeing in her features. The Observable force continued flowing into her form from every direction, rivers of golden light that painted the isolated sanctuary in hues that should not have been possible within such a small space.
|Status Effect ’Temporal Dilation’ is active. One instant is being stretched toward infinity.|
Ultimately, she spoke.
"The longer your Infinities remain in my body, the more risk you run for yourself."
Her voice emerged with authority that pressed against the boundaries of this domain, each word carrying implications that demanded careful consideration.

"What happened during the time that I chose to live like you and all others will have far-reaching consequences. Giving you the chance to spread your weavings inside of me has made this possible. I cannot blame you, but I can advise you on exactly how things should unfold from here."
Noah’s eyes remained sharp as he listened to her words.

Her choosing to live like them? With that phrasing, he could infer a great deal. She had been something else, had deliberately become something lesser, and now had reverted to what she originally was. The tattoos, the bands, the way Observable force flowed toward her as if she were its natural destination, all of it made sense when framed as restoration rather than transformation.
But what exactly was she now?
"So you were living among us as us."
Noah’s voice emerged steady despite the flood of Observable force still burning through his foundations via the Quintessence Infiniforce connection.
"What have you reverted back to now? Why do I feel this flood of Observable Force rushing from your existence?"

Eon looked at him calmly, her golden eyes holding an assessment that felt clinical rather than personal. She was studying him as one might study an interesting specimen, determining how much information he could handle, how much he deserved to know.
"Others I would not bother too much with."
She glanced toward the frozen form of THE Primordial Paradox.
"Even Paradox I was sentimental about and said a few things. You...are a case study that will already be of interest to us. I just did not want that interest to become a verdict of your end."
Her expression shifted slightly.

"There is much you and even I do not know, but Existence is too vast and has been going on for too long. Your history, the history of our Observable Existence, my history, all of it is a flicker of dust in overall Existence."
She paused to let those words settle.
"You have been alive for an insignificant amount of time. So have I. So have countless others. Eons before we were born, Existence has been ongoing. Lifeforms have been ongoing."
Her golden eyes held his without wavering.
"And across Existence, there are different types of lifeforms. There are those like you, and there are those like me."

Noah’s gaze turned heavy as he absorbed these words. Different types of lifeforms. Not different in terms of power or cultivation or achievement, but different in terms of fundamental nature. The distinction she was drawing went beyond what many had encountered in their journey through Observable Existence!
But he continued to listen calmly, permitting her to explain what she meant.
"You, Primordial Architects, THE Creature, THE Primordial Paradox, THE Living Paradox, every single one of you are lifeforms born and drenched in Adversity in the Scales of Existence."
Her voice held no condescension, only statement of fact.
"You are THE Bounded."
|Classification Revealed: THE Bounded.|
|Definition: Lifeforms born and drenched in Adversity.|
The words pressed against Noah’s awareness.
"I am not drenched in Adversity."
Eon’s golden tattoos shimmered as she spoke, their patterns pulsing with light that seemed to respond to her declarations.
"I am part of them. THE Gilded."
|Classification Revealed: THE Gilded.|
|Definition: Lifeforms fundamentally distinct from THE Bounded. Not subject to the same unknown limitations. Reason for the reaction of Observable force.|
"I could act and play a role to be like you, which is what I did for eons. But you could never be like me. No matter what you do. No matter how much you Persevere."
She tilted her head slightly.
"That is a doctrine of Vakochev, by the way. To Persevere no matter what across the Scales. But Existence Engineered you already to never be capable of much."
Her words were not cruel. They were simply true, at least from her perspective.
"That already is a gulf enough. Understanding that is what I told Paradox here, and I will tell you somewhat more."
She gestured vaguely upward, toward heights that existed beyond this isolated sanctuary.
"Above you, THE Bounded, are those like me, THE Gilded. And above me are THE Primeval. Even I am not some grand being. I am just a bit higher on the totem pole."
|Classification Structure Detected:|
|Tier 1: THE Bounded - Lifeforms drenched in Adversity.|
|Tier 2: THE Gilded - Lifeforms above Adversity.|
|Tier 3: THE Primeval - Classification unknown. Above THE Gilded.|
Ruination’s peompts continued to flash before his eyes as he listened, with her weavings breaking down everything she wss receiving as she made a grand database.
"That is how vast Existence is. So much more exists that you cannot even imagine."
Eon’s voice carried no triumph in these revelations, only the weariness of someone explaining obvious truths to those who had never been permitted to see them.

"You look at Observable Existence and think that is it. You do not think about all others that are Observable. You do not think of all that which is Unobservable. You do not think of all that exists in between. You do not know of the Designations."
She paused, and when she continued, her voice held something approaching a warning.
"But something supremely critical is how those within their Designations remain within their Designations."
"By connecting yourself to me with your Quintessence Infiniforce as you have, you...are violating your Designation."
WAA!
