chapters.title: Chapter 5061: What Are You? III
paragraphs: The words landed with a magisterial force that pressed against Noah’s foundations.

"Even if I do nothing and I veil it as much as possible, it will be known. For such a violation, it does not matter who you are. Even if you are a unique case study among THE Bounded for your usage and resistance to Infinity that does not belong to your form of life, they will end you for your transgression."
|Warning: Existential threat detected.|
|Threat Level: Beyond current parameters.|
|Cause: Quintessence Infiniforce connection to a Gilded lifeform.|
Her golden eyes met his with intensity that cut through the clinical detachment she had been maintaining.
"Which is why I told you to remove your Quintessence Infiniforce from me. Save yourself, Osmont."
BOOM!

The words settled across the isolated sanctuary with finality that pressed against everything within range. Eon stood there with grandeur and imperious bearing that declared her nature as something fundamentally beyond what he had believed her to be. An extraordinary air shone around her form, golden light radiating outward.
She was not merely powerful.
She was different.

She was THE Gilded, and he was THE Bounded, and according to everything she had just explained, that distinction mattered more than any amount of cultivation or advancement or achievement could ever overcome.
Noah looked at her seriously as he took in all her words.

His mind processed everything as he looked back at all the prompts from Ruination. THE Bounded. THE Gilded. THE Primeval. A hierarchy of lifeforms that existed beyond the Scales of Existence he had been climbing, beyond the classifications of Primordial Architects and Singular Cognizances he had been learning, beyond anything Observable Existence had revealed to him.
He was supposed to be insignificant in this grand scope.
He was supposed to be minor.
He was supposed to be a flicker of dust in overall Existence, a being whose entire history amounted to nothing compared to the eons that had preceded his birth.
His eyes shone with a light of tyranny at being told how minuscule he was.

He knew he was young. He knew this truth intimately, had known it since the moment he began perceiving beings who had existed for eons beyond counting while he had lived for mere moments in comparison. He understood his youth. He accepted his youth.
But he was also grand.
Oh, he was grand.

The Observable force flooding into him from Eon’s existence continued burning through his foundations, and THE Hadean Organ of Civilization continued spinning to process it, and his Quintessence Infiniforce continued acting as pathways that apparently violated Designations he had never known existed.
He was THE Bounded, she said.
He was limited by Existential Engineering, she said!
He could never be like her no matter what he did, she said.
Noah stood there in his illusory form, looking at THE Secretive Eon with expression that held no fear, no despair, no acceptance of the limitations she had just described.
Only tyranny.

Only the absolute certainty that regardless of what Existence had engineered him to be, regardless of what Designations he was supposed to remain within, regardless of what they would do to him for his transgressions, he would become something that made their classifications seem small.
He knew he was young.
But he was also grand!
As his eyes shone with imperious light, Eon looked at him as if she understood everything his gaze stood for.

She shook her head calmly before turning to look out toward the edge of this small domain, where swirling weavings of Unobservable pressed against the boundaries that separated this sanctuary from the vastness beyond. Her expression shifted into something contemplative, something almost wistful in ways that did not match the supremacy she had been radiating since the moment he arrived.
"I see your defiance."
Her voice emerged softer than before.
"I was similar once. Perhaps I still am."
She paused, golden eyes fixed upon distances that existed beyond the mile-wide domain surrounding them.

"When I first became aware of what I was, of what THE Gilded meant compared to everything else in Existence, I felt as though I did not belong anywhere. THE Bounded could not understand me. Other Gilded seemed content with their positions, with the natural superiority we were born into, with accepting the hierarchy as it was designed. I was not content."
Her hands touched the golden bands upon her wrists, fingers tracing patterns that seemed older than most Existences.

"I watched THE Creature make choices of his own volition. I watched him embrace Adversity when he had no need to, experiment with forces that could have unmade him, reject everything he was supposed to be in pursuit of something he wanted to become. I watched Primordial Architects struggle and fail and succeed and fail again, each mistake shaping them into something different than what they had been before."
She turned slightly, her profile illuminated by the golden light still flowing into her form.

"I wanted that. I wanted to make my own choices and my own mistakes. I wanted to experience Existence differently than how I was supposed to experience it. The role of THE Gilded felt hollow when I had done nothing to earn it. I had been born into supremacy rather than achieving it."
Her expression shifted into something that resembled regret.

"So I sealed myself. I locked away what I was and chose to live as THE Bounded, to experience Adversity as they experienced it, to struggle as they struggled, to feel the weight of limitations I had never known before."
She released a breath that seemed to carry centuries of accumulated experience.

"And mistakes I made. So many mistakes. I convinced myself that persevering through challenges without my true nature was noble, was meaningful, was something that would make me understand Existence in ways I could not have understood otherwise. I even looked at the Adversity THE Creature and Erwin engineered and promised myself I would strip them of their distinctions as Keys of Civilizations of our Observable Existence and take them myself or give them to others."
Her golden eyes closed briefly.

"I was even foolhardy enough to allow a fungus of a Primordial Architect to take over my existence. THE Primordial Mycelia seized control of me, used me as a puppet, violated everything I was, and I did not unseal myself because of my pride. Because I told myself that unsealing would mean admitting failure, would mean my experiment had concluded in defeat."
She opened her eyes and turned to face Noah directly.
"I made mistakes. Eons worth of them. Some taught me things I could not have learned otherwise. Most simply hurt."
Her gaze held his with intensity that pressed against his awareness.
"Do not make the same mistakes as me."
The words emerged with conviction that seemed to surprise even her.
"I can afford to make mistakes. You cannot. Mistakes for me are a slap on the wrist, a minor inconvenience, a lesson that carries no permanent consequence. A single mistake for you isextinction."
She stepped closer to his illusory form, golden light radiating around her with each movement.

"You do not need what I have. You are already exceptional enough among THE Bounded. Your resistance to Infinity, your weavings, your progression, all of it marks you as unique within your Designation. Just take your Quintessence Infiniforce away and save yourself."

chapters.title: Chapter 5062: Defiance! I
paragraphs: Noah listened to her words with the attention they deserved.

Her story was not what he had expected. Pride and foolishness and the desire to experience something beyond the role she had been assigned, these were motivations he could understand even if he could not entirely relate to them. She had made herself lesser because being greater felt unearned. She had suffered because she refused to admit that her experiment had failed.
He could respect that, even as he refused to follow her advice.
"Where I grew up, there was a private school near the public school I attended."
His voice emerged with calm that matched her earlier composure.

"Vastly different institutions. The private school had uniforms and gates and parents who drove expensive vehicles. The public school had metal detectors and overcrowded classrooms and teachers who had stopped caring years before I arrived."
He observed her expression shift into curiosity at his unexpected response.

"Some days during lunch, I would walk to a park that sat between these two vastly different worlds. And in that park, I befriended a girl from the private school. She was beautiful, intelligent, and kind in ways that suggested she did not realize how different our circumstances actually were."
Noah’s illusory form shifted slightly, memories he had not accessed in what felt like eternities surfacing with clarity that surprised him.

"When her friends found out about our friendship, they cornered me. They told me the two of us were in different worlds. They said I needed to stop pushing myself around her, that she was just being nice to someone as little as me. She was far above. I was below."
His eyes met Eon’s golden gaze with defiance that had not diminished since childhood.
"Tell me, do you think I stopped seeing that girl?"
He did not wait for her to answer.

"She was a baddie. And I never stopped seeing her until she went abroad. She was supposed to be out of my league. Everyone told me so. Her friends told me so. Her parents eventually told me so. I did not care."
His smile held the tyranny that had defined him since before he understood what tyranny meant.
"So tell me, what do you think I will do in this situation?"
His words were grand, declarations that refused to acknowledge the hierarchies being described to him!

Eon looked at him calmly again. She did not reply to his story, did not attempt to explain why his analogy was flawed, did not point out that the consequences of defying Existential Designations were somewhat different than the consequences of defying private school social hierarchies.
She simply observed him as one might observe a specimen confirming expected behavior.
Noah looked at her as another question formed in his awareness.
"As a Gilded Lifeform, why is so much Observable force flowing into you? You seem to have so much that my weavings inside of you cannot help but transmit it over."
Eon’s expression shifted into something approaching patience.
"THE Gilded are blessed and nurtured by all that which is Observable."
Her voice held the tone of someone explaining fundamentals to those who had never been permitted to learn them.

"Contextually not infinite, but all Gilded have access freely to an almost endless amount of Observable force. Traversing the lower Scales of Vakochev’s Existence is easier for us. All THE Bounded never gaze upon anything past Proterozoic."
She looked at him with directness that permitted no misunderstanding.
"You...will never gaze upon anything past Proterozoic."
|Advancement limitation confirmed for Bounded Lifeforms.|
|Maximum ceiling: THE Proterozoic Scale.|
"THE Gilded can progress past THE Second Scale with time. It is simply how we were born. Access to Observable is merely one of the perks."
Her golden tattoos pulsed with light that seemed to emphasize her words.

"We interact with the Scales differently. We have resistance to Infinity and much more unlike what any Bounded can imagine. I am telling you all of this, but it seems worthless as it does not seem like you will change your path."
Noah’s eyes remained firm with tyranny as he processed her words.

THE Bounded could never progress past THE Proterozoic Scale. That was the ceiling Existence had engineered for his kind. That was the limitation he was supposed to accept, the boundary he was never supposed to cross, the height beyond which he was never supposed to gaze.
He nodded slowly.
"If I have gotten my hooks on one of the perks of THE Gilded through you, why should I let go?"
His smile held conviction that refused to acknowledge impossibility.
"I want to enjoy what you are enjoying."
|Decision Registered: Quintessence Infiniforce connection will be maintained.|
Eon looked at him silently for a long moment.
"Had you not helped my foolish past self with that fungus, I may have forced you to do what I am saying."
Her voice emerged measured and final.
"As a thank you, I will not. But my choice to thank you this way can also be considered your catastrophe, as I know what it will bring for you in the future."
She turned away from him, her form beginning to shimmer with light that suggested imminent departure.
"You have made your choice. I will not go back and forth on it with you. Just be ready."
She paused, looking back over her shoulder.
"When they do inadvertently find out, you can find ease in the fact that they will only care about you. They will only extinguish you. Your family or any of those under you would be untouched."
Her golden eyes held his one final time.
"So at least there is that. Your choice will only bring about your own ruin, and others will mourn you."
Noah’s eyes shone sharply at her words.
"What about you who allowed this to happen?"
Eon’s calm reply emerged with the certainty of someone stating mathematical truth.
"I told you. I get a slap on the wrist. You get extinction."
HUUM!
With such words, her figure rose as she began to flicker out of Observable Existence.
Golden light gathered around her form. She was departing , returning to existences he had never known existed until moments ago.
Noah looked at her defiantly as she looked back at him.
The two held their gazes across the distance separating them, Gilded and Bounded, superior and inferior according to Designations he refused to acknowledge.

He would not remove his Quintessence Infiniforce from her existence. He would not surrender the Observable force flowing into him through those pathways. He would not accept the extinction she predicted with such casual certainty.
Ultimately, she sighed.
Then...she disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 5063: Defiance! II
paragraphs: |Entity Departed: THE Secretive Eon.|
|Status Effect ’Temporal Suspension’ has ended.|
|Domain Status: Normalized.|
The freezing power that had held everything in place vanished instantly.

THE Primordial Paradox unfroze as if no time had passed at all, his obsidian titanic form completing whatever motion he had been making before Eon’s power locked him in place. His massive head turned toward where she had been standing, found nothing, then shifted to observe Noah’s illusory form floating nearby.
His expression changed through several configurations before settling on bewildered frustration.
"Fucking hell."
His voice emerged with exhaustion that seemed inappropriate for someone who had just achieved THE Second Scale.
"You are not going to tell me you are some Gilded grandiose lifeform too, right?"

Noah floated closer to THE Primordial Paradox, observing the changes that had occurred within him. The aura radiating from that obsidian form declared Proterozoic authority with intensity. Something had fundamentally shifted within those foundations.
He sighed at the question.
"No, I am not something like that."
His illusory form settled beside the massive Primordial Paradox.
"But hey, THE Second Scale for you. Congratulations."
|Entity Analysis: THE Primordial Paradox.|
|Current Scale: THE Proterozoic Scale - Rhyacian Tier.|
|Civilizational Anchor: Established. Composition: Paradox.|
|Proterozoic Bone Detected: THE Paradoxical Sternum.|
|Location: Chest cavity, integrated with ribcage.|
|Capabilities: Allows simultaneous channeling of contradictory authorities. Enables existence in mutually exclusive states. Full parameters unknown, requires testing.|
THE Primordial Paradox’s expression twisted into something between gratitude and offense.
"Congratulations what? I did not even do it myself."
His obsidian hand pressed against his chest where his newly formed Proterozoic Bone resided.
"The all-important Gilded Lifeform who has apparently left just tapped out twice to form my Anchor for me and this Proterozoic Bone. Fucking hell."
Noah observed Paradox gazing at his chest bone.

His own eyes shone brightly as he processed the implications. A few taps from Eon had taken THE Primordial Paradox to THE Second Scale. Casual gestures from a Gilded Lifeform had accomplished what should have required a great fucking deal, what should have demanded absolute self-knowledge!
She had done it with taps.
Then he truly would not release the Quintessence Infiniforce flowing through her existence.

The Observable force continuing to pour into him was insane, volumes that his Hadean Organ of Civilization processed with efficiency that prevented overflow but could not prevent awareness of just how much was coming through. His own power and progression would be jumping tremendously as his foundations absorbed what a Gilded Lifeform considered casual excess.
|Incoming Observable Force: Continuous.|
|Processing Status: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization operating at elevated capacity.|
|Projection: Significant advancement imminent across multiple parameters.|
But with everything somewhat clearer regarding Eon and her nature, he could return his attention to Beowulf.

The Second Scale Primordial Architect was still waiting in THE Wastes, held in check by revelations that should have been impossible for Noah to know. Alexander was still there as well, ready for the confrontation that had brought them to that transformed landscape. The illusory screens were still broadcasting everything to Observable Existence.
As he thought this through, he came to sit beside Paradox within this isolated sanctuary.
"What happened with Erwin?"
Indeed. Whatever happened to THE Living Paradox that Noah knew at this moment in time...had arrived in the same location as another body of his and Naldine Manthon in Nakatsukuni?
THE Primordial Paradox sighed, and he began to talk.
While wonders unfolded all around him, Noah returned his attention to the body facing Beowulf.

In that region of THE Wastes filled with multicolored seas and endless rain, the instant stretched toward infinity concluded as he refocused his awareness. His illusory form in the isolated sanctuary remained as his consciousness settled fully into the body floating before a Second Scale Primordial Architect who had grown extremely serious during his momentary absence.
He looked around to sense what had changed.
|Environmental conditions have shifted dramatically.|
|Proterozoic Suppression Field detected. Source: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor.|

The heavy Proterozoic Scale power Beowulf had laid down pressed against everything within range. This was battlefield control exercised by someone who had decided casual exchanges were no longer acceptable.
|Status Effect ’Proterozoic Containment’ is active. No entity without a Proterozoic Bone can leave this region. Boundaries extend for surrounding gigaparsecs.|
|Status Effect ’Scale Diminishment’ is active. All First Scale power reduced by 99% within affected zone.|
|Status Effect ’Authority Drain’ is active. Civilizational Authorities are being siphoned from all non-Proterozoic entities at rate of 3% per second.|
|Status Effect ’Infinity Rejection’ is active. All Infinity-based weavings experience 75% efficiency reduction.|
|Status Effect ’Observable Suppression’ is active. Observable force channeling reduced by 80% for First Scale beings.|
Noah smiled at the comprehensive suppression Beowulf had established during his momentary distraction.

This fucker had gotten really, really serious. The multicolored seas around them had stilled completely, frozen not by ice but by authority that demanded all movement cease until permitted. The endless rain had stopped falling, droplets suspended in configurations that declared Beowulf’s dominance over this entire region of transformed space.
His Hadean Organ of Civilization released a burst of multicolored light from within his chest.

He grasped his Spear of Civilization tighter as the organ spun with fury that rejected everything attempting to constrain him, the force of THE Infiniverse erupting out. The Observable force continuing to flood into his existence from Eon’s pathways provided fuel that Beowulf’s suppression could not account for. His foundations burned with golden light that pressed outward against every status effect seeking to impose itself upon his form.
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Proterozoic Containment’.|
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Scale Diminishment’.|
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Authority Drain’.|
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Infinity Rejection’.|
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Observable Suppression’.|
|Status: All hostile effects nullified for you.|
|Extending nullification field to designated ally: Alexander.|
|Status: All hostile effects nullified for Alexander.|
HUUM!

The suppression that should have crippled any First Scale entity simply dissolved around Noah and Alexander, their existences protected by authority that operated according to different rules than what Beowulf understood.
Noah looked at the massive Primordial Architect floating in the distance, that armored form radiating fury that had only intensified during his absence.
"Sorry about that. I had to take care of something for a second."
His voice emerged with casual confidence that pressed against the tension saturating this region.
"We can continue now."

Noah observed Paradox gazing at his chest bone.
His own eyes shone brightly as he processed the implications.
A few taps from Eon had taken THE Primordial Paradox to THE Second Scale.
Casual gestures from a Gilded Lifeform had accomplished what should have required a great fucking deal, what should have demanded absolute self-knowledge!
She had done it with taps.
Then he truly would not release the Quintessence Infiniforce flowing through her existence.

The Observable force continuing to pour into him was insane, volumes that his Hadean Organ of Civilization processed with efficiency that prevented overflow but could not prevent awareness of just how much was coming through.
His own power and progression would be jumping tremendously as his foundations absorbed what a Gilded Lifeform considered casual excess.
|Incoming Observable Force: Continuous.|
|Processing Status: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization operating at elevated capacity.|
|Projection: Significant advancement imminent across multiple parameters.|
But with everything somewhat clearer regarding Eon and her nature, he could return his attention to Beowulf.
The Second Scale Primordial Architect was still waiting in THE Wastes, held in check by revelations that should have been impossible for Noah to know.
Alexander was still there as well, ready for the confrontation that had brought them to that transformed landscape.
The illusory screens were still broadcasting everything to Observable Existence.
As he thought this through, he came to sit beside Paradox within this isolated sanctuary.
"What happened with Erwin?"
Indeed.
Whatever happened to THE Living Paradox that Noah knew at this moment in time...had arrived in the same location as another body of his and Naldine Manthon in Nakatsukuni?
THE Primordial Paradox sighed, and he began to talk.
While wonders unfolded all around him, Noah returned his attention to the body facing Beowulf.
In that region of THE Wastes filled with multicolored seas and endless rain, the instant stretched toward infinity concluded as he refocused his awareness.

His illusory form in the isolated sanctuary remained as his consciousness settled fully into the body floating before a Second Scale Primordial Architect who had grown extremely serious during his momentary absence.
He looked around to sense what had changed.
|Environmental conditions have shifted dramatically.|
|Proterozoic Suppression Field detected.
Source: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor.|
The heavy Proterozoic Scale power Beowulf had laid down pressed against everything within range.
This was battlefield control exercised by someone who had decided casual exchanges were no longer acceptable.
|Status Effect ’Proterozoic Containment’ is active.
No entity without a Proterozoic Bone can leave this region.
Boundaries extend for surrounding gigaparsecs.|
|Status Effect ’Scale Diminishment’ is active.
All First Scale power reduced by 99% within affected zone.|
|Status Effect ’Authority Drain’ is active.
Civilizational Authorities are being siphoned from all non-Proterozoic entities at rate of 3% per second.|
|Status Effect ’Infinity Rejection’ is active.
All Infinity-based weavings experience 75% efficiency reduction.|
|Status Effect ’Observable Suppression’ is active.
Observable force channeling reduced by 80% for First Scale beings.|
Noah smiled at the comprehensive suppression Beowulf had established during his momentary distraction.
This fucker had gotten really, really serious.
The multicolored seas around them had stilled completely, frozen not by ice but by authority that demanded all movement cease until permitted.
The endless rain had stopped falling, droplets suspended in configurations that declared Beowulf’s dominance over this entire region of transformed space.
His Hadean Organ of Civilization released a burst of multicolored light from within his chest.
He grasped his Spear of Civilization tighter as the organ spun with fury that rejected everything attempting to constrain him, the force of THE Infiniverse erupting out.
The Observable force continuing to flood into his existence from Eon’s pathways provided fuel that Beowulf’s suppression could not account for.
His foundations burned with golden light that pressed outward against every status effect seeking to impose itself upon his form.
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Proterozoic Containment’.|
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Scale Diminishment’.|
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Authority Drain’.|
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Infinity Rejection’.|
|Immunity Triggered: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization has negated ’Observable Suppression’.|
|Status: All hostile effects nullified for you.|
|Extending nullification field to designated ally: Alexander.|
|Status: All hostile effects nullified for Alexander.|
HUUM!

The suppression that should have crippled any First Scale entity simply dissolved around Noah and Alexander, their existences protected by authority that operated according to different rules than what Beowulf understood.
Noah looked at the massive Primordial Architect floating in the distance, that armored form radiating fury that had only intensified during his absence.
"Sorry about that.
I had to take care of something for a second."
His voice emerged with casual confidence that pressed against the tension saturating this region.
"We can continue now."

chapters.title: Chapter 5064: Merely Rhyacian! I
paragraphs: Beowulf looked at him silently and coldly.

The Primordial Architect no longer spoke, no longer offered threats or declarations or promises of violence to come. He existed in a state of immense focus and grandeur that communicated everything through posture rather than words. His hammer was grasped in his hand, that weapon containing a Proterozoic Bone now held ready for strikes that would not be exploratory.
He was truly serious.
Noah turned to Alexander, who floated beside him with an expression that held bloody peace rather than fear.
"Give me a few seconds to wear him down, and then you can tag in."
Alexander nodded lightly. He understood that Noah needed to establish something first.
Noah began to float toward Beowulf.

As he did so, his Organ of Civilization buzzed with activity that pressed against his awareness. The terrifying force it had received from Eon’s existence, that flood of Observable power that continued pouring through Quintessence Infiniforce pathways, began channeling toward his right hand.
The hand holding the Spear of Civilization. The hand that would bear the weight of this confrontation.
|THE Hadean Organ of Civilization is inducing formation of a Hadean Bone within your right hand.|
|Process: Observable Force Integration.|
|Source: Gilded Lifeform connection providing accelerated resources.|
|Estimated completion: Unknown. Dependent on combat intensity and force channeling.|
|Current progress: 0%.|

The bones of his right hand began to tremble as the spear grasped within them buzzed with resonance that matched his foundations. Noah’s eyes shone brilliantly as he felt boundless Quintessence Infiniforce and Observable force flooding into his hand with intensity.
The boons of being connected to a Gilded Lifeform began to show.

His hand burned with golden light that seeped through his skin, illuminating the bones beneath with brilliance that declared transformation in progress. He could feel his phalanges trembling, his metacarpals vibrating, his carpals shifting as Observable force saturated them with authority they had never been designed to contain.
But he went ahead toward Beowulf regardless.
"Come on, big guy! For all of Observable Existence to see!"
His voice rang across the stilled battlefield with challenge that could not be ignored.
"Come on!"
HUUM!
Beowulf moved.
|Civilization Activation Detected: Armed Existence.|
|Civilization Ability: Absolute Armament Strike. All weapons wielded become extensions of wielder’s foundations. Damage ignores Civilizational defenses.|

The massive hammer descended with speed that contradicted its enormous size. Crimson light blazed from the Proterozoic Bone within as Beowulf channeled everything he possessed through the weapon designed specifically for destruction. The air itself screamed as the hammer fell, reality protesting the force being applied against its fabric!
Noah raised his Spear of Civilization to meet it.
CRACK!

The collision sent shockwaves rippling outward across the stilled battlefield. Multicolored seas that had been frozen by Beowulf’s suppression were not merely disrupted but erased entirely, vast expanses of transformed water simply ceasing to exist as the force of their exchange pressed through them. The suspended rain droplets within a light year of their position vaporized simultaneously!
HUUM!
|Impact Assessment: Attack blocked. Strain detected in your foundations.|
|Hadean Bone Formation: 7% complete.|
Noah felt the impact reverberate through his arm with intensity that made his teeth clench. Holding his ground was possible, but it was not easy. He was Immovable!
Beowulf possessed power refined across eons of existence at THE Second Scale. The gap between them was real!
But the gap was closing.

Beowulf withdrew his hammer and swung again with motion that carried the momentum of the first strike into a second assault. The crimson Proterozoic Bone blazed brighter as he channeled even more authority through its configurations.
|Civilization Ability Detected: Cascading Armament.|
|Effect: Each consecutive strike increases in power by factor of 1.5. No known upper limit.|

Noah met this strike as well, his spear intercepting the descending hammer with precision that placed crystalline tip against crimson bone. The Observable and Unobservable forces swirling around his weapon pressed against Beowulf’s authority with intensity that made the Primordial Architect’s massive form actually shift backward slightly.
BOOM!
Another light year of multicolored seas vanished.
|Impact Assessment: Attack blocked. Strain increasing.|
|Hadean Bone Formation: 15% complete.|

The third strike came faster than the second, Beowulf’s massive form moving with speed that should have been impossible for something so large. His hammer arced down from angles that seemed to change mid-swing, the Civilization of Armed Existence allowing his weapon to move in ways that contradicted normal physics.
Physics didn’t even matter as they were being violated thoroughly!
|Civilization Ability Detected: Impossible Trajectory.|
|Effect: Weapon can alter direction after swing commences. Conventional blocking ineffective.|
Noah did not attempt conventional blocking.

He thrust his spear forward to meet the hammer before its trajectory could shift, endless blue seas of infinity converging on the spear tip, intercepting the weapon at the source of its motion rather than attempting to catch it at its destination!

His crystalline spearhead pressed against the hammer’s shaft just below the head, Infinity, Observable and Unobservable forces grinding against the crimson bone with friction that generated light visible across the remaining seas.
CRACK!
The impact almost drove Noah backward for the first time, his body buzzing through suspended rain droplets that vaporized upon contact with his passage. He didnt move, but thr space around him was!
The space came to a stop three light years from where he had been, his right arm burning with pain that the transformation within was simultaneously amplifying and soothing.
|Impact Assessment: Partial block. spatial displacement detected.|
|Hadean Bone Formation: 23% complete.|
|Warning: Incoming follow-up attack.|
Beowulf was already there.

The Primordial Architect had crossed the distance separating them with speed that demonstrated why THE Second Scale represented such a fundamental advancement over THE First. His hammer descended again, fourth strike of a cascade that would only grow more devastating with each successful connection.
Noah raised his spear.
The weapons collided with force that created a sphere of absolute destruction expanding outward from their point of contact.

Everything within that sphere simply ceased to exist, matter and energy and authority all dissolved by the violence of their exchange. The multicolored seas of THE Wastes, which had covered this region for as far as anyone could see, were being systematically erased by their confrontation.
|Impact Assessment: Attack blocked. Foundational strain approaching thresholds.|
|Hadean Bone Formation: 31% complete.|
|Observable Force influx: Compensating for damage.|
The golden light in Noah’s right hand burned brighter.

He could feel the bones transforming, could sense the metacarpals shifting into configurations that should not have been possible for any First Scale entity. The Observable force from Eon’s existence poured through his Quintessence Infiniforce pathways with volume that accelerated the process beyond what natural formation would have permitted.
Ozymandias...may actually not be needed for this.
Beowulf swung again.
Fifth strike. Power increased by factor of 7.59 from the baseline.
Noah met it with a swing of his own.

For the first time in their exchange, he did not simply block but attacked, his Spear of Civilization moving to intercept Beowulf’s hammer while simultaneously pressing toward the armored chest behind it. The Observable and Unobservable forces swirling around his weapon condensed into majesty!
BOOM!
The collision halted both weapons simultaneously.

Neither combatant moved for an instant that seemed to stretch toward eternity. Noah’s spear pressed against Beowulf’s hammer with force that neither could overcome. The Proterozoic Bone within that weapon ground against the Civilizational Armament that should not have existed at THE First Scale, and for one perfect moment, they were equals.
|Impact Assessment: Stalemate achieved.|
|Hadean Bone Formation: 47% complete.|
Then Beowulf pressed harder.

The Primordial Architect’s massive form leaned into the exchange, bringing the full immensity of his Second Scale existence to bear against Noah’s resistance. His hammer began pushing the spear back, centimeter by centimeter, his superior Scale asserting itself through raw application of force that methodology alone could not overcome.
|Warning: Stalemate breaking. Enemy advantage increasing.|
|Hadean Bone Formation: 52% complete.|

Noah felt his arm straining under the pressure. The bones of his right hand burned with transformation that was occurring too slowly, Observable force flooding into structures that were not yet ready to channel what they were receiving. He needed more time. He needed the formation to complete before Beowulf’s cascade reached heights he could no longer match!
He needed to hold on!
"Is that all you have?"
His voice emerged strained but defiant.
"I expected more from THE Primordial Armor. But in the end, you are merely a Rhyacian Proterozoic Lifeform!"
WAA!
Beowulf did not respond with words.
He responded with the sixth strike.
|Civilization Ability Detected: Terminal Armament.|
|Effect: Final strike of cascade sequence. All accumulated power released simultaneously.|

The hammer rose and fell with speed that made everything before seem leisurely by comparison. All the accumulated force of the cascade, every factor of increase built across six consecutive exchanges, compressed into a single descending blow that would end this confrontation one way or another.
Noah met it with everything he had.
|Hadean Bone Formation: 67% complete.|
CRACK!

chapters.title: Chapter 5065: Merely Rhyacian! II
paragraphs: The impact created devastation that spread across the remaining multicolored seas like a wound expanding through flesh.

Everything within ten light years of their collision simply disappeared, transformed into nothing by forces that existence itself could not withstand. Noah felt his arm screaming with pain, his bones burning with transformation that was being forced toward completion by the violence demanding expression through them.
He held his ground.
Barely!

His feet, if feet could be said to exist in this space of floating combat, pressed against nothing and found purchase anyway. His foundations refused to retreat further. His will, that tyrannical certainty that had defined him since before he understood what power meant, declared that he would not be moved!
Fuck that!
|Hadean Bone Formation: 78% complete.|
|Observable Force influx: Critical volume achieved.|
|Transformation acceleration detected.|

Beowulf pressed harder, putting everything behind the strike that was supposed to end Noah’s existence. His armored face contorted with effort that seemed inappropriate for someone who should have been ending this exchange with casual superiority. He was struggling!
THE Primordial Armor was struggling against a First Scale entity.
|Hadean Bone Formation: 89% complete.|
Golden light erupted from Noah’s right hand with brilliance that painted the destroyed battlefield in hues that had nothing to do with the multicolored seas that had previously occupied this space.

His bones blazed with transformation reaching completion, Observable force crystallizing into golden rivers around him that declared his hand to be something fundamentally different from what it had been moments before.
|Hadean Bone Formation: 95% complete.|
|Hadean Bone Formation: 99% complete.|
|Hadean Bone Formation: Complete.|
HUUM!
Noah’s right hand became visible through his flesh as the bones within shone with imperious gold that pressed outward against the skin containing them.

Every structure within that hand blazed with light that declared transformation accomplished, authority crystallized into physical form through methodology that should not have been possible at THE First Scale.
His carpals glowed golden at his wrist. The metacarpals all radiated with Observable force that had been integrated into their very composition.
His metacarpals blazed with brilliance that extended from wrist to knuckles, five bones that now channeled authority their original design had never anticipated.

His phalanges shone brightest of all, fourteen bones forming his fingers and thumb that now grasped the Spear of Civilization with grip that could not be broken by any force Beowulf could bring to bear.
|Hadean Bone Formation Complete.|
|Designation: THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp.|
|Components: All carpals, metacarpals, and phalanges... of right hand transformed through Observable Force integration.|

|Capability:Grip strength now theoretically infinite. Anything grasped cannot be released except by wielder’s will. Force channeled through hand is multiplied by a factor of Observable concentration.|
|Full capabilities unknown. Field testing in progress.|
Noah grasped his Spear of Civilization with his newly transformed hand.

The weapon buzzed with resonance that seemed almost joyful, as if the crystalline armament recognized that its wielder had finally developed a grip worthy of what it contained. Observable and Unobservable forces swirled around the spear with intensity that exceeded anything he had channeled before, golden and clear rivers pressing outward from the weapon’s tip with fury that demanded release.
Beowulf felt the change.

The Primordial Architect’s eyes, invisible behind that armored helm, widened as he perceived what had just occurred within Noah’s existence. His hammer, still pressing down against the spear blocking it, began to vibrate with frequencies that suggested strain rather than dominance.
Noah smiled with tyranny that had no trace of mercy.
He pushed.
CRACK!
His newly transformed hand channeled force through the Spear of Civilization with intensity that exceeded everything he had managed before this moment!

The Observable force from Eon’s existence, the Unobservable weavings integrated into his weapon, the Quintessence Infiniforce saturating his foundations, all of it condensed into a single point of contact between crystalline spear and crimson-boned hammer.
Beowulf’s weapon began to crack.
|Damage Detected: Enemy weapon structural integrity compromising.|
|Proterozoic Bone within hammer experiencing resonance overload.|

The Primordial Architect attempted to withdraw, to create distance that would allow him to reassess this confrontation that had shifted so dramatically against his expectations. His massive form pulled backward with speed that demonstrated Second Scale capabilities even in retreat.
Noah did not permit retreat.

THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp closed tighter around his spear as he thrust forward with motion that carried the accumulated force of their entire exchange into a single piercing strike. The crystalline tip of his weapon pressed against the hammer that Beowulf was attempting to interpose between them.
BOOM!
The hammer... exploded.
|Enemy Weapon Status: Destroyed.|
|Proterozoic Bone Status: Exposed. No longer integrated into armament structure.|
HUUM!

The weapon that had terrorized countless existences across eons of conflict simply ceased to exist as a unified construct. Metal and authority and accumulated enchantment all dissolved outward in rings of destruction that pressed against everything within range. Only the crimson obsidian Proterozoic Bone that had been integrated into its structure remained, that single transformed component falling through the space where the hammer had been.
Beowulf stared at his empty hands with shock that pressed against the fury he had been maintaining.
Noah did not pause to appreciate the moment.
His newly transformed hand grasped his Spear of Civilization as he swung with motion that felt impossibly heavy and impossibly fast simultaneously!

The Observable force crystallized into his bones channeled through every aspect of the strike, golden light trailing behind the weapon’s arc like a comet burning through atmosphere that did not exist.
A massive crescent of golden brilliance erupted from his spear’s path.

The strike surged forth across the distance separating him from Beowulf with speed that exceeded what the Primordial Architect’s shocked state could process. Sharp multicolored edges bordered the golden crescent, Quintessence Infiniforce, Observable and Unobservable forces woven together!
It smashed onto Beowulf’s massive figure.
OH!
BOOM!
|Strike Impact: Direct hit confirmed.|
|Target Status: Armor breached.|

The armor that had defined THE Primordial Armor since before most current beings had learned to exist received a diagonal cut from shoulder to waist. Metal that should have been impervious to anything THE First Scale could produce parted like flesh before a blade, edges glowing with heat that had nothing to do with friction.
Beneath that parted armor, something was revealed that Noah had not expected.

Wriggling physiology that resembled nothing human or humanoid occupied the space where internal organs should have resided. Living metal that moved with autonomous purpose, tendrils of animate armor that had grown into Beowulf’s existence so thoroughly that the distinction between being and equipment had long ago ceased to have meaning.
And alongside that horrifying revelation, a roar erupted from Beowulf’s armored helm.
"OOOOOH!"

It was the first sound the Primordial Architect had made since their genuine combat began. Lividity and pain mixed together in that bellow that echoed across the destroyed battlefield, across the space where multicolored seas had once spread as far as anyone could see, across the illusory screens that continued broadcasting everything to Observable Existence.
THE Primordial Armor had been wounded.
THE motherfucking Youngest had drawn blood!

The metacarpals all radiated with Observable force that had been integrated into their very composition.
His metacarpals blazed with brilliance that extended from wrist to knuckles, five bones that now channeled authority their original design had never anticipated.

His phalanges shone brightest of all, fourteen bones forming his fingers and thumb that now grasped the Spear of Civilization with grip that could not be broken by any force Beowulf could bring to bear.
|Hadean Bone Formation Complete.|
|Designation: THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp.|
|Components: All carpals, metacarpals, and phalanges... of right hand transformed through Observable Force integration.|
|Capability:Grip strength now theoretically infinite.
Anything grasped cannot be released except by wielder’s will.
Force channeled through hand is multiplied by a factor of Observable concentration.|
|Full capabilities unknown.
Field testing in progress.|
Noah grasped his Spear of Civilization with his newly transformed hand.
The weapon buzzed with resonance that seemed almost joyful, as if the crystalline armament recognized that its wielder had finally developed a grip worthy of what it contained.

Observable and Unobservable forces swirled around the spear with intensity that exceeded anything he had channeled before, golden and clear rivers pressing outward from the weapon’s tip with fury that demanded release.
Beowulf felt the change.
The Primordial Architect’s eyes, invisible behind that armored helm, widened as he perceived what had just occurred within Noah’s existence.
His hammer, still pressing down against the spear blocking it, began to vibrate with frequencies that suggested strain rather than dominance.
Noah smiled with tyranny that had no trace of mercy.
He pushed.
CRACK!
His newly transformed hand channeled force through the Spear of Civilization with intensity that exceeded everything he had managed before this moment!

The Observable force from Eon’s existence, the Unobservable weavings integrated into his weapon, the Quintessence Infiniforce saturating his foundations, all of it condensed into a single point of contact between crystalline spear and crimson-boned hammer.
Beowulf’s weapon began to crack.
|Damage Detected: Enemy weapon structural integrity compromising.|
|Proterozoic Bone within hammer experiencing resonance overload.|
The Primordial Architect attempted to withdraw, to create distance that would allow him to reassess this confrontation that had shifted so dramatically against his expectations.
His massive form pulled backward with speed that demonstrated Second Scale capabilities even in retreat.
Noah did not permit retreat.
THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp closed tighter around his spear as he thrust forward with motion that carried the accumulated force of their entire exchange into a single piercing strike.
The crystalline tip of his weapon pressed against the hammer that Beowulf was attempting to interpose between them.
BOOM!
The hammer... exploded.
|Enemy Weapon Status: Destroyed.|
|Proterozoic Bone Status: Exposed.
No longer integrated into armament structure.|
HUUM!
The weapon that had terrorized countless existences across eons of conflict simply ceased to exist as a unified construct.
Metal and authority and accumulated enchantment all dissolved outward in rings of destruction that pressed against everything within range.
Only the crimson obsidian Proterozoic Bone that had been integrated into its structure remained, that single transformed component falling through the space where the hammer had been.
Beowulf stared at his empty hands with shock that pressed against the fury he had been maintaining.
Noah did not pause to appreciate the moment.
His newly transformed hand grasped his Spear of Civilization as he swung with motion that felt impossibly heavy and impossibly fast simultaneously!

The Observable force crystallized into his bones channeled through every aspect of the strike, golden light trailing behind the weapon’s arc like a comet burning through atmosphere that did not exist.
A massive crescent of golden brilliance erupted from his spear’s path.
The strike surged forth across the distance separating him from Beowulf with speed that exceeded what the Primordial Architect’s shocked state could process.
Sharp multicolored edges bordered the golden crescent, Quintessence Infiniforce, Observable and Unobservable forces woven together!
It smashed onto Beowulf’s massive figure.
OH!
BOOM!
|Strike Impact: Direct hit confirmed.|
|Target Status: Armor breached.|
The armor that had defined THE Primordial Armor since before most current beings had learned to exist received a diagonal cut from shoulder to waist.
Metal that should have been impervious to anything THE First Scale could produce parted like flesh before a blade, edges glowing with heat that had nothing to do with friction.
Beneath that parted armor, something was revealed that Noah had not expected.
Wriggling physiology that resembled nothing human or humanoid occupied the space where internal organs should have resided.

Living metal that moved with autonomous purpose, tendrils of animate armor that had grown into Beowulf’s existence so thoroughly that the distinction between being and equipment had long ago ceased to have meaning.
And alongside that horrifying revelation, a roar erupted from Beowulf’s armored helm.
"OOOOOH!"
It was the first sound the Primordial Architect had made since their genuine combat began.

Lividity and pain mixed together in that bellow that echoed across the destroyed battlefield, across the space where multicolored seas had once spread as far as anyone could see, across the illusory screens that continued broadcasting everything to Observable Existence.
THE Primordial Armor had been wounded.
THE motherfucking Youngest had drawn blood!

chapters.title: Chapter 5066: Anchored And Bound! I
paragraphs: As Beowulf was pushed back with a heavy injury, Noah moved with unfathomable momentum that his newly transformed hand granted him.

The Primordial Architect was reeling, that diagonal wound across his chest exposing wriggling internal physiology that should never have been revealed to anyone at THE First Scale. His armored form attempted to create distance, to establish the space necessary to recover and reassess this confrontation that had shifted so dramatically against his expectations.
Noah did not permit distance.

He threw his Spear of Civilization upward with motion that carried the full force of THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp behind it. The crystalline weapon rose above the destroyed battlefield, above the space where multicolored seas had once spread as far as anyone could see, above everything that remained in this devastated region of THE Wastes.
The light of Quintessence Infiniforce shone upon the ascending spear with brilliance that painted the suspended rain droplets in hues of endless authority!
|Civilization Ability Activated: Spear Multiplication.|
|Quintessence Infiniforce channeling through THE Hadean Spear of Civilization.|
|Illusory constructs forming.|

Instantly, eight illusory Spears of Civilization materialized around the original weapon. They emerged from the Quintessence Infiniforce like reflections given substance, each one identical to the crystalline Kontos that had deflected Proterozoic attacks and shattered a Second Scale weapon. Nine spears now hung in the air above Beowulf’s wounded form, their multicolored brilliance declaring intention that could not be mistaken.
Waves of golden Observable force wrapped around each weapon.

The eight illusory spears oriented themselves toward Beowulf’s extremities with precision that permitted no evasion. They descended simultaneously, piercing through armored limbs with force that pinned the massive Primordial Architect in ways he could not escape. Two spears through each arm. Two spears through each leg. Eight points of anchorage that held his titanic form suspended in the destroyed air.
The main Spear of Civilization, the original weapon containing the full force of THE Infiniverse multiplied and raised by exponents that defied calculation, descended toward Beowulf’s head.
It pierced through his armored helm with sound that echoed across the remaining light years of battlefield.
CRACK!
"FUCKEEER!"
Beowulf roared with voice that emerged for only the second time since their genuine combat began.

His body became suspended in the air, held aloft by nine spears that channeled forces he could not overcome despite every aspect of his Second Scale existence straining against them. His massive armored form hung there like a specimen prepared for examination, like something that had been captured rather than defeated, like prey that had finally been brought down by a predator it had underestimated.
|Target Status: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor.|
|Condition: Anchored.|
|Anchoring Force: Boundless flow of Quintessence Infiniforce, Infinity, and concentrated Observable Force channeling through nine Spears of Civilization.|
|Target Resistance: Active. Subject is fighting against anchoring with full Second Scale authority.|
|Assessment: Resistance insufficient. So long as the Spears of Civilization continue to channel their deluge of forces, target will remain anchored.|
|Estimated duration of effective anchoring: Indefinite under current parameters.|
Noah moved after confirming the anchoring was secure.

His small figure, insignificant compared to the massive Primordial Architect suspended before him, flew across the distance separating them with speed that his transformed existence now permitted. He approached Beowulf’s chest, that torn expanse of armor revealing the wriggling physiology beneath, and came to land upon it as if standing upon conquered territory.
He stood on the wound he had inflicted.

His gaze was grand and tyrannical as he looked down at the armored head struggling against the spear that had pierced through it. Beowulf’s invisible eyes, hidden behind that helm, burned with fury that pressed against everything within range despite his immobilized state. The Primordial Architect was not broken. He was merely held.
But being held was enough.
Noah turned to look into the distance where Alexander had been waiting.
He waved his hand with a casual gesture that belied the significance of what he was permitting.

Alexander flew across the destroyed battlefield. His figure crossed the light years separating him from the anchored Primordial Architect in moments, his green robes trailing behind him as the Enneagram upon his chest spun with all nine gems blazing. He did not slow as he approached.
He smashed onto the chest of Beowulf beside Noah.
BOOM!
His gaze was chilly and cold as he looked at Beowulf and then at his companion, at the one who had made this moment possible through confrontation that should not have succeeded.
"Thank you."
The words emerged simple and sincere.
Noah nodded in acknowledgment before stepping back slightly, ceding the space to someone who had earned what was about to occur.
Alexander turned to look at Beowulf.

The Primordial Architect’s armored form continued straining against the nine spears anchoring him in place. His massive limbs pulled against the illusory weapons piercing them, his head twisted against the crystalline spear that had penetrated his helm, his entire existence fought against the imprisonment that had been imposed upon him.
None of it accomplished anything.
"I was impatient, so I asked for help."
Alexander’s voice emerged measured and cold, the tone of someone who had made peace with what they were about to do long before arriving at this moment.
"While I will not have a grand battle with you, I can come in at the end to allow you to feel what I felt."

White gloves appeared upon Alexander’s hands, materializing from authority that seemed designed specifically for this purpose. The material was pristine and clinical, the kind of covering one might wear when performing surgery rather than torture. His fingers flexed within those gloves as he looked down at the torn chest beneath him, at the wriggling internal physiology that had been exposed by Noah’s earlier strike.
Noah watched as Alexander reached into that wound.

His gloved hands pressed past the parted armor, past the animate metal that tried to resist his intrusion, past every defense that Beowulf’s existence could muster against what was occurring. Alexander’s fingers found something within that wriggling physiology, grasped it with precision.
|Alexander has activated unknown ability.|
|Effect: Existential Nociceptor visualization.|
|This ability should only be accessible to Second Scale entities.|
|Analysis: Alexander’s Enneagram is providing elevated perception despite First Scale classification.|

Alexander’s Enneagram began to spin faster, all nine gems blazing with multicolored light that pressed outward from his chest. His hands became covered with that same multicolored brilliance, authority flowing through his fingers into the depths of Beowulf’s existence as they held glimmers of Noah’s Quintessence Infiniforce.
Something...began to rise from within the Primordial Architect!

chapters.title: Chapter 5067: Anchored And Bound! II
paragraphs: A system of receptors became visible that should only have been perceptible to those at THE Second Scale. They emerged from Beowulf’s internal physiology like a nervous system being extracted from flesh, except these were not nerves in any biological sense.
These were the fundamental architectures through which all suffering flowed, the structures that Beowulf himself had described when he tortured Alexander across millions of years of subjective time.
Vibrant crimson vessels spread outward from the wound in Beowulf’s chest!

They resembled a network of veins or nerves, branching and subdividing into configurations that covered the Primordial Architect’s entire existence. The Existential Nociceptors blazed at the center, fundamental receptors that served as the foundation for everything else. From them extended the Civilizational Afferents, pathways that could carry agony through one’s entire Civilization simultaneously.

The Delta-Threads of Existence were visible as sharper, faster conduits designed for immediate pain transmission. The C-Fibers of Being appeared as slower, thicker vessels that carried burning anguish without relief. And scattered throughout the network were the Polymodal Agony Receptors, rare structures that responded to multiple types of suffering at once.
All of it was now visible.
All of it was now accessible.
Alexander looked at the system he had revealed with an expression that held no mercy.
"Not long ago, I experienced these receptors for what seemed like millions of years."
His voice remained calm despite the subject matter.

"You isolated every Existential Nociceptor within my existence. You mapped my Civilizational Afferents with precision that left no pathway untouched. You activated my Polymodal Agony Receptors while flooding my Delta-Threads and C-Fibers with stimulation that exceeded anything I was designed to endure."
His gloved fingers traced along one of the crimson vessels with touch that seemed almost gentle.

"You applied Hyperalgesic Amplification until my receptors were sensitized beyond theoretical maximums. You dilated my perception of time until each moment of torture stretched into spans that would reduce civilizations to begging."
He paused.
"I wish... to repay the favor. For the sake of Peace. So that I can sleep at night. You screams will serve as my lullabies."
Noah watched this exchange from his position on Beowulf’s chest.

The Primordial Architect’s armored head opened as much as the spear piercing it would permit, revealing darkness within that somehow managed to convey expressions despite possessing no visible features. Beowulf roared with fury that shook the nine spears anchoring him, his massive form straining against imprisonment that his full Second Scale authority could not overcome.
It accomplished nothing.
The anchoring held.
|Alexander has commenced manipulation of target’s Existential Nociceptors.|
|Target Status: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor.|
|Current experience: Initial isolation of fundamental pain receptors.|
|Civilizational Afferents: Being mapped.|
|Delta-Threads of Existence: Identified and prepared for stimulation.|
|C-Fibers of Being: Identified and prepared for sustained activation.|
|Polymodal Agony Receptors: Located. Activation sequence initiating.|
|Hyperalgesic Amplification: Commencing.|
|Target resistance: Ineffective. Pain architecture now under Alexander’s control.|

Alexander’s hands moved with precision that spoke of expertise earned through personal experience. He knew these receptors intimately. He knew exactly how they functioned, exactly how they could be manipulated, exactly what configurations would produce suffering that exceeded anything existence was designed to endure.
He knew because Beowulf had taught him.
|Hyperalgesic Amplification: Sensitivity increasing.|
|Factor: 100x baseline.|
|Factor: 1,000x baseline.|
|Factor: 10,000x baseline.|
|Factor: Continuing to escalate. No upper limit detected.|
"Wait...WAIT- OOOH!"
Beowulf’s roars shifted into something else as the amplification took hold.
|Temporal Dilation: Activating around target’s pain receptors.|
|Objective time: 1 nanosecond.|
|Subjective experience: 1 year.|
|Objective time: 2 nanoseconds.|
|Subjective experience: 1,000 years.|
|Dilation continuing to compress objective time against subjective perception.|
The sounds emerging from Beowulf’s armored form became screams.

Noah observed all of this from his position on the Primordial Architect’s chest. He watched Alexander work with hands that had become crimson with something that might have been blood if Second Scale entities possessed blood in any conventional sense. He watched the network of pain receptors pulse with activity that exceeded anything they had been designed to transmit.
He watched Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor, experience exactly what he had inflicted upon others across eons of cruelty.
He looked up at the illusory screens that continued displaying everything to Observable Existence.

They captured Beowulf’s screams with clarity that spared no detail. They showed Alexander’s clinical precision as he activated receptor after receptor. They broadcast the moment when a Second Scale Primordial Architect was subjected to torture by beings at THE First Scale, held immobile by spears that should not have been able to anchor him, broken down by methodology he himself had perfected.
There were many things one could do with friends.
Some friends helped you move to new domains. Some friends supported you through difficult cultivation breakthroughs. Some friends provided advice when existence seemed overwhelming.
Right now, Noah was aiding in the torture of a Proterozoic Scale Primordial Architect before the eyes of all Observable Existence.
He found he was comfortable with that!
|Target Status: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor.|
|Subjective time experienced: 47,000 years of continuous agony.|
|Objective time elapsed: 0.00004 seconds.|
|Hyperalgesic Amplification: Factor now exceeds measurable parameters.|
|All Existential Nociceptors: Firing without cessation.|
|All Civilizational Afferents: Flooded with maximal stimulation.|
|All Delta-Threads: Transmitting sharp, immediate pain continuously.|
|All C-Fibers: Carrying burning anguish without relief.|
|All Polymodal Agony Receptors: Screaming with multiple agonies simultaneously.|
|Assessment: Target is experiencing everything he inflicted upon Alexander, amplified by methodology refined through personal understanding of suffering.|
The screams of Beowulf echoed across the destroyed battlefield.

They carried through the space where multicolored seas had once spread for as far as anyone could see. They pressed against the suspended rain droplets that had not yet fallen. They broadcast through the illusory screens that transmitted everything to beings across Observable Existence who watched with expressions ranging from horror to satisfaction to careful notation of what was being demonstrated.
THE Primordial Armor screamed as THE Peacemaker got bloody.

Alexander’s white gloves had turned entirely crimson now, stained with whatever passed for vital fluid within a Second Scale Primordial Architect. His expression held nothing but focus as he continued his work, as he repaid every moment of the millions of years he had experienced during his own torture. His Enneagram spun with all nine gems blazing, the construct that he had shattered to protect Noah now serving as the instrument through which he delivered justice.
The screams did not stop!
They would not stop for a very long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 5068: Obsession!
paragraphs: <On the Importance of Hobbies>
In retrospect, holding down a Proterozoic Scale Primordial Architect while his friend methodically butchered him was one of the more memorable bonding experiences Noah had in Observable Existence.
There is something to be said for shared activities.

Some friends cultivate together. Some explore Primordial Realms together. Some engage in philosophical discourse about the nature of Infinity and what it means for existence itself. Noah and Alexander chose to anchor a Second Scale torturer with nine spears while one of them systematically activated every pain receptor in his body across millions of years of subjective suffering.
Different strokes...for different folks.

The point is that one must make time for hobbies. Existence is long, particularly when one possesses Infinity, and the relationships that sustain a being across eons are not built through grand declarations or dramatic oaths alone.

They are built through moments. Through experiences. Through looking at one’s companion while he is elbow-deep in the chest cavity of a screaming Primordial Architect and thinking..."Yes. This is quality time."
It is said that friendship requires effort.
It is said that meaningful connections demand investment.
Noah held down a being at THE Second Scale so that his friend could repay millions of years of torture in kind, and he broadcast the entire thing across Observable Existence for everyone to see.
If that is not investment, what is?
Take time for your hobbies. Cherish your friendships. And if those hobbies happen to involve the systematic dismantling of those who wronged the people you care about, well.
At least you are doing it together.
<Prima Indifferentia>
The multicolored seas of Prima Indifferentia embraced THE Living Emotive as she floated through waters that should not have existed in this ancient realm.
Her loose clothing billowed around her form, dark fabric spreading through the transformed liquid like ink dissolving in water. Her curvaceous body with its many blessings could barely be seen!

The Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity had reached even here, filling basins that had been empty since before differentiation taught existence how to distinguish itself. She swam with lazy strokes that suggested meditation rather than travel, her body drifting through warmth that pressed against her skin with authority she recognized as belonging to someone specific.
His authority, hs Infinity, his touch spreading across Observable Existence and reaching her here!

Above the transformed seas, illusory screens blazed with images that demanded her attention. They displayed a battlefield where multicolored seas had been erased entirely, where a massive Primordial Architect hung suspended by nine spears that should not have been capable of anchoring anything at THE Second Scale. They showed two figures standing upon that anchored form, one observing with tyrannical calm while the other worked with hands that had become crimson.
Osmont and a nobody by his side were torturing a Primordial Architect.
The manic light in Emotive’s eyes blazed brighter as she watched.

Her lips parted in expression that might have been smile or might have been hunger. The screens captured every detail with clarity that spared nothing. Beowulf’s screams. The guy’s precision. And Osmont, standing there with golden rivers of Observable force swirling around his form, overseeing the dismantling of a Primordial Architect.
He was magnificent! He was terrifying.
He was everything she had ever wanted and could not yet reach.
In Existence, there were many unique and talented beings scattered across Observable and Unobservable alike.
But those who made the most advancements were not always the most talented.

They were those with tremendous conviction. Those who believed in something so completely that reality itself bent around their certainty rather than the other way around. Those who looked at impossible gaps and saw only distances that had not yet been crossed. Talent mattered, certainly. Resources mattered!
But conviction was the multiplier that made everything else meaningful.

And even if crazy and unstable, even if broken in ways that others could not comprehend, there could be an entity so filled with conviction that their talent exceeded what many others could even imagine. Someone whose obsession became methodology, whose fixation became fuel, whose madness became the very foundation upon which impossible advancement was built.
THE Living Emotive was such an entity.
She knew this. Even if she was crazy, what if that craziness only added to her Civilization?
Her dark hair shone with light. Her eyes, locked onto the illusory screen displaying Noah’s golden-wrapped form, held intensity that would have unsettled anyone capable of perceiving it.
"To even get close to you, I will need to be so much more."
Her voice emerged soft and certain, words spoken to an image that could not hear them, to a man who did not know or care that she was watching, to an obsession.

"So with my Claim on Chaos, with my Bond to THE Creature and THE Living Paradox...I truly and fully pull on all the negative emotions across Observable Existence for the first time since THE Infinite Unfurling."
Her hands spread outward through the multicolored waters, fingers extended as if grasping something invisible.

"This time, all emotions where Chaos spreads. From Primordial Architects. From Undivided Ones. From anything in any corner of Observable Existence pertaining to emotions and the chaos they hold. From all of Existence and Paradox..."
Her eyes blazed with manic light that exceeded anything she had permitted herself to express before.
"Give them all to me."
BOOM!

Her body began to vibrate with frequencies that pressed against the transformed seas around her. The multicolored waters churned in response to what she was pulling toward herself, currents disrupting as something vast began converging upon her position from every corner of Observable Existence.
Hazy violet rivers formed in the air above the seas.

They came from every direction simultaneously, streams of condensed emotion flowing toward her form with inevitability that could not be resisted. Rage and despair and hatred and grief and jealousy and resentment, all of it pulled from beings who did not know they were being harvested, all of it converging upon THE Living Emotive as she floated in waters that belonged to the one she obsessed over.
But the violet rivers were not alone.

Golden rivers began forming alongside them, streams of Observable force that should not have been connected to emotional harvesting. They wound around the violet currents like companions that had always been meant to travel together, converging upon Emotive’s form with the same inevitability that governed the emotions she was claiming.

She was taking all emotions across Observable Existence at such a profound level that the very force of Observable began to flow into her. The connection between emotion and perception, between feeling and acknowledgment, between internal experience and external recognition, all of it was being pulled through her Claim with intensity that blurred the boundaries between different types of authority.
It was astounding how the same power, the same Claim, held by a different person could be used so uniquely.

Abaddon had held Chaos for eons beyond counting. He had used it to spread influence, to corrupt domains, to establish presence across Observable Existence without ever fully leveraging what it could accomplish. He had been content with what he possessed rather than hungry for what he could become.
THE Living Emotive was never content.
She was always hungry.

At this moment, Emotive radiated an aura that entirely exceeded any common Absolute at THE First Scale. The violet and golden rivers continued pouring into her form, each stream adding to foundations that were expanding beyond what her previous limitations had permitted. She was going toward distinctions others could only imagine, toward heights that beings with more stable minds would never attempt to reach.
The Broken Doll held a terrifying obsession and conviction.

At this time, she rose up in distinction while her eyes remained locked onto a man in an illusory screen whose entire body was surrounded by golden rivers of Observable. He did not know she was watching. He did not know she was growing. He did not know that every moment he spent becoming greater only intensified her determination to become greater alongside him.
She would reach him and she would stand beside him!

The violet and golden rivers continued converging upon her form as she floated in his transformed seas, her manic smile never wavering, her conviction never faltering, her obsession burning brighter than any stable mind could sustain!
