chapters.title: Chapter 5069: Barbaric!
paragraphs: In the spaces between Observable and Unobservable, darkness reigned absolute.
This region existed outside normal classification, a pocket of reality that belonged to neither the seen nor the unseen but occupied the bleeding edge where both forces met and failed to reconcile.

The air here was thick with authority that predated most current beings, pressure that would have crushed any existence lacking sufficient foundation to withstand it. Light came from no discernible source, yet somehow illumination existed.
Blood covered everything.
Crimson and gold mixed together across surfaces that should not have been able to hold liquid, pooling in depressions that formed patterns.
The smell of death permeated the space with intensity, pressing against awareness itself with declarations of violence recently concluded.
THE Creature sat upon a throne of corpses.

Horus lay beneath him, that ancient Primordial Architect who had terrorized regions of Observable Existence. His massive form stretched across the bloody ground, armored scales that had deflected countless attacks now torn and shattered in configurations of violence beyond what even Second Scale entities should have been able to inflict upon each other.

His chest cavity had been opened, ribs of crystallized authority spread apart like petals of some grotesque flower, revealing internal structures that pulsed weakly with fading life that refused to fully extinguish.
His eyes were gone, of course.
THE Creature had already displayed those to Observable Existence, had held them aloft as trophies for all to witness. But the rest of Horus remained, and what remained was being consumed.
Two other corpses flanked the fallen Horus.
The first belonged to a Proterozoic Scale Primordial Architect whose domain had once encompassed concepts of hidden knowledge and forbidden understanding.

His form was humanoid but wrong. His skin, where it remained intact, held patterns of script in languages that predated speech itself. Three Proterozoic Bones shone within his ravaged chest, their multicolored brilliance declaring their nature even in death. His spine had been partially extracted, vertebrae of transformed authority scattered around him like discarded jewelry.
The second corpse belonged to a Primordial Architect whose Civilization had revolved around bindings and contracts and obligations that could not be broken.

Her form was feminine in the way that weapons were feminine, elegant and deadly and designed for purposes that had nothing to do with comfort. Chains of solidified authority still wrapped around her limbs, broken now but still present, remnants of the power she had wielded before THE Creature decided she would wield it no longer.

Two Proterozoic Organs pulsed weakly within her opened torso, one where her heart should have been and another nestled against her spine, both radiating light that was slowly dimming as death claimed what life had built.
Three Proterozoic Scale Primordial Architects.
Three corpses arranged around THE Creature like offerings!

THE Creature himself sat upon Horus’s chest. Multicolored flames burned around his figure, fire that consumed nothing but illuminated everything with hues that existence rarely witnessed in such concentration.
His form was humanoid but ancient.
At this moment, one could see that all his bones held multicolored brilliance.

Every single piece of bone within THE Creature’s existence shone with the distinctive light of Proterozoic transformation. His skull blazed beneath flesh that seemed almost translucent in the flames’ illumination.

His ribs pressed outward against his chest with radiance that exceeded the corpses around him. His spine, his pelvis, his femurs and tibias and fibulas, every phalanx in his fingers and toes, all of it had been transformed!
He was not merely at THE Second Scale!
Oh!
Oh!!
He was something that made THE Second Scale seem like a waystation rather than a destination!
And he was eating.

A Proterozoic Eye Organ of Horus rested in THE Creature’s hands. THE Creature bit into it, his jaw working as crimson gold blood and viscera leaked down his chin and chest. The sounds of consumption were wet and horrible, flesh tearing and fluid spilling and authority being absorbed into foundations that were already beyond what most existences could comprehend.
He ate like a beast.
He ate like something that had abandoned pretense of civilization in pursuit of power that civilization could never provide.
And while he ate, he watched.
An illusory screen floated before him, displaying images that had been broadcast across Observable Existence through Noah’s spread Infinities.

The screen showed THE Youngest standing upon the chest of Beowulf, that massive Primordial Architect anchored by nine spears while another worked within his opened chest cavity. It showed torture being inflicted upon a Second Scale entity by beings who should not have been capable of such infliction.
THE Creature watched with eyes that held satisfaction.
Blood dripped from his chin as he observed Osmont’s work, remembering their fight long ago.
At this time, the fabric of this bloody domain shifted.

A figure stepped through barriers that should have been impenetrable, his scholarly robes somehow remaining pristine despite the carnage surrounding his point of arrival. Anaximander looked around the space with an expression that shifted from neutral to disturbed as he processed what he was observing.
His gaze moved across Horus’s ravaged corpse.
It traveled to the other scattered remains.
It settled upon the other Architect’s opened form before finally fixing upon THE Creature himself, who continued eating without acknowledging the new arrival.
Anaximander frowned at the scene of blood surrounding him.
"We waited for you for too long in THE Lands of the Dead."
His voice emerged measured despite the horror around him.
"You never came so I came to check. I did not expect this level of barbarity."

THE Creature bit into the Proterozoic Eye Organ again, more crimson gold fluid spilling down his chest as he chewed with deliberation that seemed almost meditative. He swallowed before responding, his voice emerging with grandeur that contradicted the savage image he presented.
"All of Existence is barbaric, Anaximander."
Multicolored flames shifted around his form as he spoke.

"We dress our violence in philosophy and call it civilization. We frame our consumption as advancement and call it cultivation. We murder and devour and destroy, and then we write histories that make our atrocities seem inevitable..."
He gestured toward the corpses around him with the partially consumed Eye Organ still in his grip.

"I simply refuse the pretense. When I consume my enemies, I do not pretend it is anything other than what it is. When I tear apart those who would have torn apart me, I do not justify it with rhetoric about necessity."
His eyes, ancient and terrible and filled with wisdom that most beings could not bear to perceive, fixed upon Anaximander with intensity.
"I am honest about what I am, Jokul."
HUUM!
Anaximander nodded slowly, accepting the explanation without necessarily agreeing with its conclusions.
THE Creature returned his attention to the illusory screen, to the image of Noah standing triumphant upon the chest of a being who should have been able to destroy him.
"THE Youngest continues to exceed all expectations though, does he not?"
The question emerged with something approaching pride.
Anaximander followed his gaze to the screen, observing the same images that were being broadcast across Observable Existence. His expression shifted into caution.
"But if he displays himself openly like this..."
He paused, choosing his words carefully.
"Will things like them not come to him in droves?"

Anaximander pointed toward the corpses of Horus and others, toward the three Proterozoic Scale Primordial Architects who had challenged THE Creature and discovered that some challenges should not be accepted.
"Beowulf should have not been alone. Others will come..."
THE Creature smiled with glory amidst his multicolored flames.
The expression held no concern, no worry, no indication that he considered these possibilities to be problems rather than opportunities. Blood still stained his chin and chest.
"That is exactly what he is looking for."
His voice emerged with certainty that pressed against Anaximander’s awareness.
"He wants the Adversity. It is good."
He bit into the Eye Organ again, more blood spilling as he chewed.
"It...is good."
The words ended cryptically.
Anaximander could not help but sigh.

He looked around at the scene of devastation surrounding this place, at the corpses of three Proterozoic Scale Primordial Architects arranged around THE Creature like trophies, at the blood that covered every surface.
The Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity had spread even here.

Multicolored rain fell from heights that should not have existed in this space between Observable and Unobservable, droplets that carried Noah’s and THE Creature’s authority whether he intended them to or not. The rain mixed with the blood covering the ground, crimson gold and multicolored brilliance combining into rivers that flowed in directions that had nothing to do with gravity.
All of those rivers surged toward THE Creature.

The blood of his enemies and the rain of existence and Infinity converged upon his seated form, absorbed by foundations that were already beyond what most existences could comprehend. He sat there eating the eye of a fallen Architect while drinking the mixed fluids of victory and transformation, his multicolored flames burning brighter with each moment that passed.
Anaximander observed all of this with a complex expression.
And...
THE Creature simply continued eating.

chapters.title: Chapter 5070: Melody! I
paragraphs: The screams of a Primordial Architect echoed out across existence.

After a certain point, Noah found them to be akin to a melody. The pitch varied with each manipulation Alexander performed upon those crimson vessels of suffering, rising when Delta-Threads were stimulated, falling when C-Fibers carried their slow burning anguish through pathways that had been designed to transmit rather than receive.
There was rhythm to it. There was almost music in the way Beowulf’s voice broke and reformed and broke again across spans of subjective time that compressed eternities into moments.
It was a symphony of revenge, and Noah served as its maim audience while Alexander conducted.

In the corner of his eyes, he could observe crimson gold blood flying every time Alexander tugged on the network of Existential Nociceptors. The fluid painted nearby regions of the destroyed battlefield in hues.

Droplets hung suspended in the air where Beowulf’s suppression field had once frozen rain, now replaced by frozen blood that would eventually fall when authority permitted gravity to remember its function.
A heavy smell hung in the air.
The smell of a Second Scale entity being unmade receptor by receptor, thread by thread, fiber by fiber!
Oh!
Noah breathed it in without discomfort.

The only thing he had done since anchoring Beowulf was wave his hand to collect what had fallen when the Primordial Architect’s hammer exploded. The Proterozoic Bone that had formed the backbone of that weapon now rested in his grip, held by THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp with pressure that would not permit escape. The crimson obsidian material buzzed against his transformed palm, vibrating with frequencies of rejection.
Noah did not care about its rejections.
He thought instead about the dangerous future ahead and the words of THE Secretive Eon.

Now, he was just told by Eon how his life was very much hanging by a thread. Existence was vast and terrible and populated by hierarchies he had never known existed. There were monsters who had been alive trillions of years beyond his lifetime, beings who operated according to Designations that classified him as something lesser before he had ever been born.

THE Bounded. That was what he was. That was what THE Creature was. That was what every being he had encountered in Observable Existence was, apparently, with the sole exception of Eon herself and others he had yet to meet or even know they exist.
He had to be a bit bold to make sure he would not be curbstomped.
He had to be a bit crazy.

Because as much as he did not want to sit with the implications, he had been told that his desecration of Eon, a Gilded Lifeform, through the Quintessence Infiniforce permeating her existence was bound to get him extinguished. They would find out. They would come. They would end him for the transgression of reaching beyond his Designation, for daring to touch what THE Bounded were never supposed to touch.

If this was truly the case, Noah could not only dismiss it or tyrannically declare that he would not give up on the access he had gained through Eon. Defiance was necessary, but defiance alone was insufficient. He had to have actual planning on how to survive should that time come. He had to understand what he was dealing with, what made THE Gilded different from THE Bounded, what Existential Engineering had been applied to separate one form of life from another.
The biggest thing remained the very connection with Eon.

He felt like if he let it go, he would lose something he might never grasp again. The Observable force flooding into him through those pathways was merely the most obvious benefit. There was more. There had to be more. Understanding that more was essential to surviving what was coming!
So he reached inward to Ruination.

"Ruination, are you able to study the existence of THE Secretive Eon with the Quintessence Infiniforce permeating throughout her? I want to see what Existential Engineering makes her Gilded and the rest of us not. I want to know the difference."
He sent these words in his mind where Ruination heard him and replied in the form of prompts that materialized before his awareness.
|Study of THE Secretive Eon’s Existential Engineering.|
|Assessment: Quintessence Infiniforce pathways provide sufficient access for covert analysis.|
|Challenge: THE Secretive Eon possesses awareness that exceeds anything known. Conducting study without detection requires extreme caution.|

|Solution: THE Hadean Organ of Civilization can process and conceal analytical weavings within the natural flow of Observable force transmission. The larger the organ grows, the more effectively analysis can be hidden within normal operations.|
|Timeline: Unknown. Gilded Existential Engineering has a lot of unknowns to us. Comprehensive understanding may require extended study.|
|Status: Study of the Weavings of Existence of THE Secretive Eon has commenced.|
|Current Progress: 0.001%.|

|Progress will accelerate as THE Hadean Organ of Civilization expands and as more Observable force is processed through Quintessence Infiniforce pathways. Early findings will be reported as they emerge.|
Noah nodded at the prompts as he fully understood what Eon represented the more time passed.

Because even now, endless rivers of golden Observable force continued to flood into him through the connection he refused to sever. His Organ of Civilization spun within his chest, processing volumes that would have overwhelmed anyone else, distributing the excess to foundations that were transforming to accommodate what they were receiving.

The organ continued to spread that light to his hands, to the bones that had already been converted into THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp. But it did not stop there. At this moment, all his bones even slightly past his shoulders were beginning to accept this light and transform.
|Transformation Progress Detected.|
|THE Hadean Hand of Infinite Grasp is serving as template for extended bone transformation.|
|Current spread: Carpal bones of wrist to Radius and Ulna of forearm to Beginning integration with Humerus of upper arm.|
|Projection: Full arm transformation imminent if current influx continues.|
|Scapula and Clavicle of shoulder girdle beginning preliminary Observable Force absorption. Transformation of upper torso skeletal structure may follow arm completion.|

|Connection to a Gilded Lifeform is providing resources that would normally require even you with your progression at least days of work into potentially just hours. THE Gilded Lifeforms present a unique opportunity of progression and advancement. Well, if they don’t collapse everything you have worked for first.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5071: Melody! II
paragraphs: The golden light spreading through his arm bones felt warm rather than painful.
Alongside this transformation, there was the organ itself.
|THE Hadean Organ of Civilization: Status Update.|
|Observable Force processed since last assessment: Volume exceeds calculation parameters.|
|Result: Organ capacity has expanded significantly.|
|Benefit Unlocked: 2 additional Civilizational Eons of Development are now available.|
|Current Civilizational Eons of Development available: 2.|
|Shall they be utilized for THE Hadean Desmoterion to observe what progress Ozymandias and others within may achieve?|
The question was a grand one.

Two more eons of development. Two more spans of compressed time within the internal prison that would allow those contained there to cultivate at rates that exterior existence could not match. Ozymandias had already achieved THE Proterozoic Scale through the first application of this capability. What could two more eons produce?
Noah did not even take an instant before he gave the command.
Both eons of development would be utilized.
|Command Accepted: Initiating Civilizational Eon of Development (1 of 2).|
|Target: THE Hadean Desmoterion and all entities contained within.|
|Time compression: One eon of subjective cultivation commencing.|
The feedback from his internal prison pressed against Noah’s awareness as compressed time began flowing through those contained foundations. He could sense Ozymandias moving within that space!
|Civilizational Eon of Development (1 of 2): Progress Report - Midpoint.|
|Entity: Ozymandias.|
|Activity: Channeling influx of Quintessence Infiniforce and Observable Force toward skeletal transformation.|
|Progress: Proterozoic Bone formation continued.|
|Current focus: Right arm and cranial structure.|
|Entity: THE Living Elemental.|
|Activity: Civilizational Anchor formation attempt successful and step towards THE Proterozoic Scale taken.|
|Civilizational Eon of Development (1 of 2): Progress Report - Conclusion.|
|Entity: Ozymandias.|
|Achievement:Proterozoic Bone formation of entire right arm completed.|
|Components: Humerus, Radius, Ulna, all Carpals, all Metacarpals, all Phalanges now transformed.|
|Additional Achievement:Proterozoic Bone formation of skull completed.|
|Components: Frontal bone, Parietal bones, Temporal bones, Occipital bone, Sphenoid, Ethmoid, and all facial bones now transformed.|
|Designation: THE Proterozoic Skull of Infinite Perception.|
|Ozymandias now possesses three Proterozoic Bone clusters. Combat capability has increased substantially.|
|Entity: THE Living Elemental.|
|Achievement: Civilizational Anchor Composition: Elemental Totality - All elements across Observable and Unobservable existence recognized as extensions of self.|
|Result:THE Living Elemental has achieved THE Proterozoic Scale.|
|First entity other than Ozymandias to achieve Proterozoic Scale within THE Hadean Desmoterion.|
THE Living Elemental had reached THE Second Scale.

The same entity Noah had beaten with Ozymandias’s legs out of vengeance had now achieved advancement that most Absolutes could never dream of reaching. But...he was still a useless bum of an existence!
|Command Continuing: Initiating Civilizational Eon of Development (2 of 2).|
|Target: THE Hadean Desmoterion and all entities contained within.|
|Time compression: Second eon of subjective cultivation commencing.|

Noah observed the progress with attention that did not waver from Alexander’s ongoing work upon Beowulf. He could perceive both simultaneously, watching crimson gold blood fly in exterior existence while sensing Ozymandias’s focused cultivation in interior foundations.
|Civilizational Eon of Development (2 of 2): Progress Report - Midpoint.|
|Entity: Ozymandias.|
|Activity: Attempting Proterozoic Organ formation rather than additional bone transformation.|
|Focus: Brain tissue. Attempting to transform neural structures into Proterozoic classification.|
|Challenge: Organ formation significantly more difficult than bone transformation. Progress slower than previous eon.|
|Current formation: 34%.|
|Entity: THE Living Elemental.|
|Activity: Stabilizing newly achieved Proterozoic Scale.|
|Progress: Adaptation proceeding normally.|
|Civilizational Eon of Development (2 of 2): Progress Report - Conclusion.|
|Entity: Ozymandias.|
|Achievement:Proterozoic Organ formation of brain completed.|
|Structure: All neural tissue, cerebral cortex, cerebellum, brain stem, and associated structures now transformed into Proterozoic classification.|
|Designation: THE Proterozoic Mind of Infinite Calculation.|
|Capabilities: Processing speed increased by factor exceeding measurement. Perception of Observable and Unobservable forces enhanced to levels approaching theoretical maximums.|
|Assessment: Ozymandias now possesses three Proterozoic Bone clusters and one Proterozoic Organ.|
|As Ozymandias exists within you and as you, all enhancements provide corresponding benefits to primary existence.|
|Civilizational Eons of Development remaining: 0.|
The moment Noah perceived these prompts, feedback surged through his existence with intensity that made him pause in his observation of Alexander’s work.
A cooling sensation began in his brain.
It spread through neural pathways that had never experienced such clarity, washing across his consciousness.
The accomplishment of Ozymandias, that Proterozoic Organ forming within the brain of his other self, resonated through their shared existence.
Noah’s thoughts accelerated.
His perception sharpened.

His awareness of everything occurring around him, from Alexander’s precise manipulations to the screaming of Beowulf to the Observable force flooding through Eon’s pathways to the transformation spreading through his arm bones, all of it became clearer than it had ever been before.
THE Proterozoic Mind of Infinite Calculation was sharing its capabilities with the one who contained it.

Noah stood upon the chest of a tortured Primordial Architect, holding a Proterozoic Bone in his transformed hand, feeling his existence expand in ways that someone like him was never supposed to experience!
As Noah ascertained his new power, he soon frowned and raised his head.
Something had changed in the surroundings.

The multicolored rain of the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity, those droplets that had been falling across this region of THE Wastes since his authority transformed it, was being dispersed and broken apart. The rain that carried his Infinity simply ceased to exist in expanding spheres of negation that approached from three distinct directions.
Auras of glorious immensity pressed against everything within range.
Auras of beings at THE Proterozoic Scale!
There were three in total, and each one radiated authority more obscene than Beowulf had managed even before Noah anchored him with nine spears!
Before their forms even became visible, an extremely deep voice boomed out across the destroyed battlefield.
"You have made your point and will be left alone. Let Beowulf go."
HUUM!
The words pressed against reality with authority that expected obedience. They were a command delivered by something that had grown accustomed to commands being followed!
After those words echoed out, the three Primordial Architects materialized from the directions their auras had been approaching.
The first was massive in ways that made Beowulf seem modest by comparison.

His form suggested a knight of impossible proportions, armor of blackened silver covering a body that had been built for war across eons beyond counting. But the armor was wrong. It had fused with the flesh beneath it, metal plates growing from skin like scales, gaps revealing not darkness but churning void that consumed light without reflecting anything.

His helm was a wolf’s skull enlarged to architectural proportions, eye sockets blazing with pale fire that saw everything. In his grip was a greatsword that stretched longer than most beings stood tall, the blade itself seeming to drink the remaining light in this region of destroyed space as it radiated a light of a complete Axiom!
Oh!
The second was not humanoid at all.

It was a mass of serpentine coils wrapped around a central body that might have once possessed recognizable form. Pale flesh covered those coils, flesh that glistened with moisture. But emerging from that pale mass were arms, dozens of them, each one ending in hands that clutched many Half completed Axioms that radiated authority even at this distance.

At the apex of those coils was something that might have been a face, features that shifted between expressions of hunger and contemplation without ever settling on either. It moved through the air as if swimming through water that did not exist, coils undulating with rhythm that hypnotized any awareness foolish enough to focus upon it too long.
The third was elegant.

He appeared almost human, a tall figure in robes of deep purple. His face was beautiful and terrible simultaneously, features too perfect to have occurred naturally. In each hand he held a curved blade that burned with fire on one side and frost on the other, flames and ice existing in impossible proximity without canceling each other. It also fucking shone with the light of a complete Axiom.

Wings emerged from his back, six of them, but they were not feathered. They were comprised of swords, thousands of blades burning with fire and ice as they formed rivers of crimson and white behind them!
Three Proterozoic Scale Primordial Architects.
Three beings who had arrived to collect their wounded companion.
Three monsters who expected Noah to comply with their command!
Noah looked at them and sensed the terrifying power they emanated. That power should have made him fearful. It should have triggered every survival instinct, should have sent him retreating.
But...
Instead, he calmly brought the Proterozoic Bone he had been holding in his transformed hand up toward his face.
He opened his mouth.
And he took a bite as he began to chew.
His teeth, enhanced by the Observable force flooding through his existence, pressed against the crimson obsidian material that had once formed the backbone of Beowulf’s hammer.
The bone cracked beneath his bite. Fragments of Proterozoic authority broke away and entered his mouth, grinding against his molars as he chewed with deliberation that seemed almost meditative.
Crimson gold fluid leaked from the corners of his lips.

The three newly arrived Primordial Architects observed this coldly. The wolf-helmed knight’s pale fires flickered. The serpentine mass’s coils stilled their undulation. The elegant figure’s perfect features twitched with distaste!
Noah swallowed.
He focused on the foremost Primordial Architect, the wolf-helmed knight who radiated power that exceeded the other two. This one had spoken. This one had issued the command!
"But...I do not feel like letting Beowulf go."

His voice emerged calm despite the crimson gold fluid still staining his chin, despite the fragment of Proterozoic Bone he continued to hold, despite the three Second Scale entities arrayed before him.
"My gut tells me the idea and concept of Beowulf will be ending here today."
He bit into the bone again, chewing as he spoke.
"He... has lived enough, and I wish to send him on his way."

His voice emerged calm despite the crimson gold fluid still staining his chin, despite the fragment of Proterozoic Bone he continued to hold, despite the three Second Scale entities arrayed before him.
"My gut tells me the idea and concept of Beowulf will be ending here today."
He bit into the bone again, chewing as he spoke.
"He... has lived enough, and I wish to send him on his way."

chapters.title: Chapter 5072: Calymmian I
paragraphs: He said heavy words while looking at what seemed to be powerful Proterozoic Scale Primordial Architects.

And he was actively eating the Proterozoic Bone of a living Primordial Architect as Beowulf’s screams became heavier behind him. The sounds shifted in pitch and intensity, showing that what Noah was doing to that crimson obsidian bone was registering through whatever remained of Beowulf’s awareness.

The bone still held connection to its former owner. Perhaps consuming it while the owner still lived created feedback that approached the agony Alexander was inflicting through those networks of Existential Nociceptors.
Either way, the screams became a harmony of suffering that Noah found himself appreciating.

At this time, Alexander looked over to Noah and then toward the three new arrivals. His gloved hands were drenched in crimson gold fluid that had accumulated across spans of torture that objective time could not properly measure. He wiped his brow with those blood-soaked gloves, leaving streaks across his forehead that he did not seem to notice or care about.
"Are we running? Or can you handle them?"

He was vengeful, but he still possessed his preservation instincts. The man who had endured millions of years of subjective torture to protect Noah was not foolish enough to die pointlessly when escape remained an option.
Noah looked at the three ahead as if measuring them.

He took another bite of the Proterozoic Bone, the sound of cracking material echoing across the destroyed battlefield with clarity that the newly arrived Primordial Architects could not have missed. Crimson gold fluid leaked down his chin as he chewed with deliberation that bordered on theatrical.
"Nah, I can handle them. You continue."
BOOM!

His eyes shone with a light of brutality and power as his existence affirmed his ongoing expression of tyranny. The words were not bravado. They were declaration of intent from someone who had decided that retreat was not among the options he would consider.
When he looked ahead, the foremost Primordial Architect was smiling.

That wolf skull helm somehow conveyed amusement despite possessing no features capable of expression. The pale fires burning in those empty eye sockets flickered with respect mixed with condescension, the look of an ancient predator observing a young one that had not yet learned its place in the hierarchy of violence.
"You are drunk on Infinity right now."
The deep voice boomed out with authority that pressed against everything within range.
"Many of us believe you to already be filled with THE Gamaidjan. You simply do not know it yet."
A pause as those pale fires studied Noah’s form.

"But regardless, you could make this into a broader conflict, or you could stop here. Primordial Architects are not loose lifeforms. Beowulf there, however he may have lost face for us today, is not alone."
The wolf-helmed figure gestured toward his two companions, toward the serpentine mass of coils and arms and the elegant figure with wings of swords.

"We could continue this and we could put to the test your power against ours. You are young and filled with Infinity, yes, but we are old and filled with many more things. Only three of us came because we are seeking to be diplomatic since Beowulf made the first move."
The pale fires in those empty sockets burned brighter.
"If this diplomacy fails..."
Noah’s eyes became sharp as he grandly took another bite in front of them.

The cracking of Proterozoic material filled the silence that followed those words. His chewing was deliberate and loud, each motion of his jaw a response to the threat that had been implied. Crimson gold fluid continued leaking down his chin as he swallowed and his eyes became chilly with an assessment that held no fear.
These fuckers. They were Bounded just like him, yet they considered themselves so powerful?

They stood before him radiating authority that would have crushed most beings at THE First Scale. They spoke of diplomacy while implying devastation should diplomacy fail. They expected him to recognize the gap between them, to acknowledge that three Proterozoic Scale entities represented a threat he could not overcome.
But Noah had broadcast what he was doing specifically to draw in more conflict and adversity.

That was the purpose of those illusory screens spreading his actions across Observable Existence. He wanted enemies to know where he was. He wanted them to come. He wanted to push himself until he was either squashed down into nothing or he rose to become something unimaginable. There was no middle path for someone who had just been told his Designation marked him for limitations he refused to accept.
He knew himself.

He knew his current power. He had himself, and then his body of Ozymandias contained within THE Hadean Desmoterion. Ozymandias was at THE Second Scale with multiple Proterozoic Bones and a Proterozoic Organ. Noah himself, while technically at THE First Scale, was forming things nobody should be able to form at his classification.
He wanted to put himself to the test!
He knew it would be brutal and painful. The three beings before him could likely inflict suffering that exceeded what Beowulf had done to Alexander.
But pain was better than extinction.
And he loved existence far too much to opt for extinction.
So.
His eyes gazed upon the three Architects ahead as their details revealed themselves to his enhanced perception.

chapters.title: Chapter 5073: Calymmian II
paragraphs: After Noah looked at the details of the most powerful one, his eyes became heavier.
Grimvault, THE Primordial Silence!

Calymmian Tier. Ninety-four percent Proterozoic Bone coverage. Four Proterozoic Organs, each one devastating in its own right. A being who had been cultivating power since before most current existences learned to crawl, who had accumulated authority that made Beowulf seem like a junior!
He had come across a truly sturdy wall.
But no matter.

Adversity was Adversity. He could never choose a comfortable level for it, could never tell existence to send him someone he could manage. That was not how growth worked. That was not how someone climbed from nothing to something that made hierarchies seem irrelevant.
He had an enemy before him he could not manage.
The first thing to do was obvious.
’Set him as a target of THE Hadean Existential Singularity.’
He sent the command to RUINATION within his foundations.
|Command Received: Hadean Existential Singularity target designation.|
|Current targets: Beowulf, THE Primordial Armor (Slot 1). Erwin, THE Living Paradox (Slot 2).|
|New target: Grimvault, THE Primordial Silence.|
|Designation: Slot 3.|
|Hadean Existential Singularity siphoning commencing.|
|Siphoning from Grimvault: Observable understanding, Unobservable understanding, Infinity comprehension, cultivation progress, Proterozoic Organ musings...|
|Target possesses significantly greater power than you. Siphoning efficiency reduced greatly.|
|Extended exposure required for meaningful extraction. Combat engagement will accelerate siphoning through direct contact.|
Noah looked over at the three Primordial Architects who were waiting for his response to their offer of diplomacy.
He opened his mouth obscenely wide.

He took larger bites, his teeth cracking through the remaining Proterozoic Bone of Beowulf with sounds that echoed across the destroyed battlefield. Crimson gold fluid sprayed with each violent mastication as he devoured what remained of that bone in moments rather than the measured consumption he had been performing before. The material ground between his molars and slid down his throat in chunks that should have been impossible to swallow.
He burped.
The sound was crude and deliberate, a punctuation to his consumption that communicated everything words could not.
"I wonder... how your bones will taste."
HUUM!
They came and spoke of diplomacy.

Noah knew there would never be diplomacy. These Primordial Architects had arrived expecting to intimidate him into releasing Beowulf, expecting that display of superior force would convince him to abandon his position. They did not want war. They wanted compliance dressed in the language of negotiation.
His words made clear that compliance was not forthcoming.

Inside of him, the Proterozoic Bone of Beowulf was digested by foundations that had grown hungry for exactly this type of sustenance. The Observable force flooding through Eon’s pathways accelerated the process, breaking down Proterozoic material into components that his existence could integrate. His whole arm and past his shoulder, bones shone even more resplendently than they had before, the consumption providing fuel for transformation that continued spreading through his skeletal structure.
And ahead of him, the light of calm and diplomacy faded from the eyes and awareness of all three Primordial Architects.

Grimvault’s pale fires burned with intensity that suggested furnaces being stoked for war. Vahrkosis’s countless arms tightened their grips on weapons and artifacts that began radiating killing intent. Sammarthiel’s wings of swords spread wider, each blade igniting with flames on one edge and frost on the other in configurations that promised devastation to anything they touched.
Instantly, the illusory screens Noah had laid out to broadcast everything to Observable Existence shattered.

The constructs that had been transmitting his confrontation with Beowulf, that had shown his torture of a Second Scale entity to all who cared to watch, simply ceased to exist as Grimvault’s authority pressed against them with force that refused their continued presence. The connection to Observable Existence was severed in an instant.
Terrifying power bloomed from all three Primordial Architects simultaneously.

The weight of their combined authority pressed against everything within range with intensity that would have crushed any normal Rhyacian Proterozoic Lifeform entity into paste. The air itself thickened with killing intent.
The fabric of reality groaned beneath pressure that threatened to tear this region of THE Wastes apart entirely!
And toward such oncoming terror, Noah jumped off Beowulf.

His figure floated away from the anchored Primordial Architect, moving toward the three entities that had just committed to hostility. His body became surrounded by golden flames of Observable force as he advanced, the endless rivers flowing through Eon’s pathways manifesting around his form in configurations that declared his own authority despite the gap between their Scales.
Golden steam shot from his nose and mouth with each breath he released.

He seemed like a primal celestial beast approaching predators who had grown too comfortable at the apex of their food chain. His eyes blazed with light that held no retreat, no calculation of odds, no recognition that three Proterozoic Scale entities represented a threat he should not be advancing toward.
"Do you think you are the only ones who banded together?"
His voice emerged with a challenge that pressed against their combined authority.
"Do you think I am alone?"
HUUM!
He said such ominous words as the brutal eyes of the Primordial Architects squinted.

Grimvault’s wolf skull helm tilted slightly, pale fires flickering. Vahrkosis’s serpentine coils stilled, all forty-seven arms pausing their preparation as something in Noah’s words demanded consideration.
The ominous air and immensity rose higher and higher.

The atmosphere itself congealed around them, thickening with authority that pressed against awareness from multiple directions. The multicolored rain of the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity that had been resuming after their initial disruption began to whip up into a storm, droplets swirling!
Because the bones of the Primordial Architect at the very forefront had glimmers of Infinity flowing through them.
Grimvault...was utilizing Infinity.
Not the same as Noah’s, not the endless wellspring that defined his existence, but traces of it woven through those Proterozoic Bones.
His mere presence stated with absolute clarity what his words did not need to speak.
Bring out whomever the fuck you wanted to bring out.

chapters.title: Chapter 5074: Storm I
paragraphs: Nakatsukuni.
The illusory screen hovering within Sadakar’s domain displayed devastation of Noah’s battle in The Wastes.
Noah watched his other body through the feed. The three newly arrived Primordial Architects filled the screen with presence that made even this distant observation feel heavy.
And then the Calymmian entity among them, Grimvault, THE Primordial Silence, dispersed the broadcast entirely with authority that simply refused its continued existence!
The screen went dark.

Naldine Manthon looked at Noah with expression that shifted through several configurations before settling on exhausted acceptance. She raised one hand to massage her forehead, fingers pressing against skin that seemed suddenly weary despite the power contained within her foundations. Her singularity-dotted eyes closed briefly as if she needed a moment to process what she had just witnessed.
She then looked toward Noah calmly, her mouth opening as if she was about to deliver rebuke that had been building since the broadcast began.

But she observed his demeanor here in this body, the complete absence of concern despite the fact that his other self now faced three Proterozoic Scale entities including one at the Calymmian Tier. He sat there with composure!
Whatever rebuke she had prepared dissolved into something more practical.
"Just... tell me where you are."
Her voice emerged measured despite the tension underlying it.

Noah looked toward her with eyes that held the same calm his other body was displaying across the vast distances separating them. The golden light of Observable force that continued flooding through his existence via Eon’s pathways made his presence here feel warmer than it had before.
"Maybe I do not need any help."
The words carried no arrogance, only statement of possibility.
Naldine’s expression hardened into something more firm.
"They will not kill your body. They will capture you."
She stepped closer to where he sat, her radiant white hair shifting with movement that seemed almost aggressive in its precision.
"Again. Tell me where you are."

The distinction she drew was important. Death was one thing. Capture was another entirely. Death could be overcome through the bodies he maintained across Observable Existence. Capture meant many more things.
Noah smiled at these words.

He waved his hand, and a vibrant singularity of information materialized between them. Coordinates and spatial markers and navigational data compressed into a form that Naldine could process instantly, the location of his other body laid bare for her to find.
She absorbed the information without acknowledgment, her attention already shifting toward the Singular Cognizance who had been observing this exchange in silence.
Naldine looked at Sadakar with gaze that held no softness.
"We all must choose sides, Sadakar."
Her voice pressed against the stellar atmosphere of this space with conviction.
"Moloch and the Peasant are here as we speak. They stand at your door, waiting to see what you will do. You can decide how you wish to handle them."

The white-blue singularity within its shifting cube pulsed with light. Sadakar had maintained neutrality across eons that most current beings could not comprehend. Being forced to choose now, in this moment, clearly did not sit well with an entity that had built its entire existence around avoiding such choices.
Naldine did not wait for his response.
She turned to Noah.
"I will go extract your other body. Send this body here away and do not try to add a Singular Cognizance as your enemy as well right now."
Her singularity-dotted eyes blazed with intensity that demanded compliance.
"You have enough enemies for one day."
With these words, she disappeared.

The stellar atmosphere of Sadakar’s domain settled into silence that pressed against Noah’s awareness. He remained alone with a Singular Cognizance, an entity from before differentiation, a consciousness that had observed existence learn how to exist.
Instead of leaving, Noah actually sat down in a meditative position.
His body settled into stillness that suggested he had no intention of departing anytime soon.
Sadakar’s contained brilliance shifted within its cube as that ancient attention fixed upon him.
"You will not be leaving?"
The question pressed against Noah with genuine curiosity.
Noah nodded calmly as he looked out toward the entrance where he and Naldine had arrived. Beyond those doors, the Peasant and Moloch came for whatever reception Sadakar would provide.
"It may be time for me to have another conversation with Erwin."
"And hey, I do not get the chance to talk to Singular Cognizances often. I am curious for anything you might know and share regarding existence."
He turned his attention toward the pulsing singularity.
"What would make someone like you choose a side, if there was any side? I do not even know the full scope of factions among Primordial Architects. Just a little view of it."
He calmly began talking to a Singular Cognizance as if this were merely pleasant conversation between two alike beings.
Elsewhere, terrifying weavings of existence unfolded as a body of his faced enemies far too powerful for his current self!
The pressure from those who were truly advanced in THE Proterozoic Scale was unique.
Hours ago, when he faced Beowulf for the first time after they tortured Alexander, Noah could not even touch the Primordial Architect initially.
His Legions had done nothing because they could do nothing.

Even now, he wanted to seek justice for them and the idea of utilizing them. They were his creations, his forces, his expressions of power that should have meant something against the enemies he faced. But until he affirmed himself at heights where such forces became relevant, they had to remain something he worked with in the background.
But back to Proterozoic Scale entities.

The only reason he had been able to interact with Beowulf at all was due to declaring himself finite and basically brute smashing the Primordial Architect with the force of Infinity he had access to. Raw power compensating for lack of methodology. Overwhelming force substituting for refined technique. It had worked because Infinity permitted things that should not have been possible.
And now, hours later, he had used the force of Infinity, Observable and Unobservable, and Quintessence Infiniforce to skewer a Rhyacian Proterozoic Lifeform like Beowulf with nine spears.
Four different forces of power.

Behind all of them were his Foundations at Uncountable Infinity and his Civilizations. The framework that held everything together, the skeleton upon which all his expressions of authority hung. His Civilizations were the vessels through which force flowed, the channels that directed raw power into meaningful action.
But this also caused him to think about his Civilizations more carefully.

He could embody any Civilization. His Organ of Civilization and Infinity and his very nature made this possible! But he had staunchly began on THE First Tongue. On the language of Existence that was connected to Mana.

Now he had Mana, and he had Infinity. He couldn’t leave behind one or the other as the backbone of how his Organ of Civilization allowed for him to express any Civilizations...was due to the versatility of Mana. It was all behind the shoulders of The First Tongue that changed the language of Existence of his Civilization to be...anything.
How much more could THE First Tongue go as the foundation of things alongside Infinity and what he was delving into now?

The enemies in front of him were using variations of the four aspects of the Oldest Paradox of Existence as their Civilizations. Chaos, First Tongue, Paradox, and Existence itself served as the frameworks, the skeletons of their power.

The forces they filled those frameworks with to further express themselves were Infinity and, if they were unique enough, perhaps they tapped into weavings of the forces of Observable or Unobservable.
Noah, on the other hand, freely utilized Infinity, Observable, and Unobservable through himself and THE Infiniverse.

And now, due to the connection with a Gilded Lifeform, he was receiving an influx of Observable force that exceeded what any Bounded entity should have been capable of accessing. Rivers of golden authority continued flooding into his existence through pathways that violated Designations he had never known existed a day ago.

With a Civilizational Anchor, those at THE Second Scale held resistance to Infinity and could form Proterozoic Bones or Organs filled with Infinity or Observable force without succumbing to its madness. They acclimated more and more power with the transformation of their bones and organs as their Civilizations became overpowering.
Which was why something like the Proterozoic Organ of Grimvault, the Lungs designated as THE Breath of Endings, could exhale authority capable of dissolving First Scale entities entirely.
The breath of that existence alone could erase him.

When it came to how he had to use such powerful beings as the hammers to make himself stronger, he had to clash against and survive against their power. Infinity was there to make everything possible, the foundation that permitted impossibilities to occur. But the other equations were the forces of Existence that seemed to be critically important.
Observable and Unobservable.

Now, why was it that a Gilded Lifeform was so blessed with a nigh endless supply of Observable? It was a force that made things very easy, with Noah processing it through his Hadean Organ of Civilization as it had helped him rapidly form new bones of his existence that now extended past his shoulders. That Observable force only added to the endlessly generating Quintessence Infiniforce inside him, and his Organ of Civilization converted both into Civilizational Eons of Development that allowed even more progression.
So the directions were clear.

He just had to Persevere under pressure until he got to the point where Grimvault became manageable like Beowulf. But from this point until then, there was a world of pain and adversity waiting for him. A gulf of suffering that had to be crossed before he could stand where these ancient monsters stood! But he welcomed it as he had to cross this gulf!
So now, he faced Grimvault, Sammarthiel, and Vahrkosis.
When faced with the question of just who could possibly side with him in this confrontation, he had implied that he... was not alone!

sentences.text: Nakatsukuni.
The illusory screen hovering within Sadakar’s domain displayed devastation of Noah’s battle in The Wastes.
Noah watched his other body through the feed.
The three newly arrived Primordial Architects filled the screen with presence that made even this distant observation feel heavy.
And then the Calymmian entity among them, Grimvault, THE Primordial Silence, dispersed the broadcast entirely with authority that simply refused its continued existence!
The screen went dark.
Naldine Manthon looked at Noah with expression that shifted through several configurations before settling on exhausted acceptance.
She raised one hand to massage her forehead, fingers pressing against skin that seemed suddenly weary despite the power contained within her foundations.
Her singularity-dotted eyes closed briefly as if she needed a moment to process what she had just witnessed.
She then looked toward Noah calmly, her mouth opening as if she was about to deliver rebuke that had been building since the broadcast began.
But she observed his demeanor here in this body, the complete absence of concern despite the fact that his other self now faced three Proterozoic Scale entities including one at the Calymmian Tier.
He sat there with composure!
Whatever rebuke she had prepared dissolved into something more practical.
"Just... tell me where you are."
Her voice emerged measured despite the tension underlying it.
Noah looked toward her with eyes that held the same calm his other body was displaying across the vast distances separating them.
The golden light of Observable force that continued flooding through his existence via Eon’s pathways made his presence here feel warmer than it had before.
"Maybe I do not need any help."
The words carried no arrogance, only statement of possibility.
Naldine’s expression hardened into something more firm.
"They will not kill your body.
They will capture you."
She stepped closer to where he sat, her radiant white hair shifting with movement that seemed almost aggressive in its precision.
"Again.
Tell me where you are."
The distinction she drew was important.
Death was one thing.
Capture was another entirely.
Death could be overcome through the bodies he maintained across Observable Existence.
Capture meant many more things.
Noah smiled at these words.
He waved his hand, and a vibrant singularity of information materialized between them.
Coordinates and spatial markers and navigational data compressed into a form that Naldine could process instantly, the location of his other body laid bare for her to find.
She absorbed the information without acknowledgment, her attention already shifting toward the Singular Cognizance who had been observing this exchange in silence.
Naldine looked at Sadakar with gaze that held no softness.
"We all must choose sides, Sadakar."
Her voice pressed against the stellar atmosphere of this space with conviction.
"Moloch and the Peasant are here as we speak.
They stand at your door, waiting to see what you will do.
You can decide how you wish to handle them."
The white-blue singularity within its shifting cube pulsed with light.
Sadakar had maintained neutrality across eons that most current beings could not comprehend.
Being forced to choose now, in this moment, clearly did not sit well with an entity that had built its entire existence around avoiding such choices.
Naldine did not wait for his response.
She turned to Noah.
"I will go extract your other body.
Send this body here away and do not try to add a Singular Cognizance as your enemy as well right now."
Her singularity-dotted eyes blazed with intensity that demanded compliance.
"You have enough enemies for one day."
With these words, she disappeared.
The stellar atmosphere of Sadakar’s domain settled into silence that pressed against Noah’s awareness.
He remained alone with a Singular Cognizance, an entity from before differentiation, a consciousness that had observed existence learn how to exist.
Instead of leaving, Noah actually sat down in a meditative position.
His body settled into stillness that suggested he had no intention of departing anytime soon.
Sadakar’s contained brilliance shifted within its cube as that ancient attention fixed upon him.
"You will not be leaving?"
The question pressed against Noah with genuine curiosity.
Noah nodded calmly as he looked out toward the entrance where he and Naldine had arrived.
Beyond those doors, the Peasant and Moloch came for whatever reception Sadakar would provide.
"It may be time for me to have another conversation with Erwin."
"And hey, I do not get the chance to talk to Singular Cognizances often.
I am curious for anything you might know and share regarding existence."
He turned his attention toward the pulsing singularity.
"What would make someone like you choose a side, if there was any side?
I do not even know the full scope of factions among Primordial Architects.
Just a little view of it."
He calmly began talking to a Singular Cognizance as if this were merely pleasant conversation between two alike beings.

chapters.title: Chapter 5075: Storm II
paragraphs: The scene before him declared the scale of what he faced with brutal clarity.

His humanoid form seemed tiny and small in comparison to the three monsters arrayed against him. Grimvault towered with that wolf skull helm blazing pale fire, his blackened silver armor fused with flesh.
Vahrkosis undulated through the air with forty-seven arms grasping Axioms.
Sammarthiel spread those six wings of swords wider, thousands of blades catching light that should not have existed in this destroyed region of THE Wastes.
Behind Noah, the screams of Beowulf continued their symphony of suffering.

Alexander’s work had evolved beyond simple torture. The crimson gold blood that had been flying with each manipulation now flowed with purpose rather than violence. The networks of Existential Nociceptors that Alexander had made visible, those vibrant crimson vessels spreading across Beowulf’s opened chest, were being extracted with precision.
|Activity Detected: Alexander is extracting Existential Nociceptor networks from Beowulf.|
|Purpose: Transplantation into own existence.|
|Alexander is incorporating the very Second Scale systems that were used to torture him into his own foundations.|
Alexander was transplanting those receptors of suffering into his own body!
But as this occurred, space flickered.
SAA!

From one of the many droplets of multicolored rain still falling across this destroyed battlefield, space paradoxically shifted. The droplet expanded and contracted simultaneously, containing more volume than its size should have permitted while remaining exactly as small as it appeared. Reality bent around that impossibility as something emerged.
THE Primordial Paradox stepped through that paradoxical distortion with presence that pressed against everything within range.
His obsidian titanic form looked majestic despite the impossibilities that composed his existence. Blue Infinity dotted that dark surface. A black crown hung loosely above his massive head.
He appeared beside Noah, looking at the enemies ahead fearlessly.

His expression shifted into a frown as he assessed what they faced. He came to float beside Noah with a posture that suggested readiness rather than hesitation, his massive form dwarfing Noah’s humanoid body.
"You really know how to pick them."
His voice emerged with the rumbling depth that obsidian given consciousness might produce.
"But this is good. After being ganged up on against my disciple, I wondered how it would feel fighting in a group."
His entrance was grand, a Proterozoic Scale entity arriving to stand beside Noah against three of his peers.
Right after, space twisted and distorted again.
The fabric of reality bent in directions that had nothing to do with paradox. Light gathered and dispersed simultaneously as another figure emerged.
WAA!
Naldine Manthon stepped through that distortion with a presence that...somewhat exceeded what Noah had felt from her before. It exceeded what he felt from her in Nakatsukuni.
What was this now?

Her blue robe billowed around her form as she arrived, that garment shifting with movement that seemed almost aggressive in its precision. Her cold gaze fixed upon the three Primordial Architects ahead with an assessment that held no warmth, no negotiation, no indication that she considered this confrontation to be anything other than what it was!
Her figure stood imperious beside Noah and THE Primordial Paradox, her singularity-dotted eyes blazing with light!
She looked ahead at Grimvault and the others as she nodded.
"Grimvault. Sammarthiel. Vahrkosis."
She spoke their names as one might speak the names of diseases that had once been survived.
WAA!
Noah’s eyes opened wide as he turned to look at her.
She knew them?
Ahead, Grimvault smiled brutally beneath that wolf skull helm.

Laughter emerged from that armored form, the sound booming across the destroyed battlefield with amusement that seemed genuine rather than performed. Those pale fires burning in empty eye sockets flickered with recognition that matched what Naldine had displayed.
"Little Naldine? Naldine THE Visionary?"
The deep voice pressed against everything within range with mocking warmth.
"Haha! I thought an idealist like you to be dead! I did not know you had already made contact with the Infinity-bearer."
Naldine looked ahead as her body began to shine with brilliance that exceeded what Noah had observed from her before.

Her blue robes shifted and transformed, fabric restructuring itself into battle garments that wrapped tightly around her form. The loose elegance that had defined her appearance since he first met her gave way to configurations designed for violence. Her radiant white hair gained a lustrous blue gold shine that painted nearby space in hues of authority preparing to be expressed.
Then she did something ridiculous.
She used her right hand... to grasp her left arm just below the shoulder.
She yanked.

Her left arm disconnected from her body with sound that should have been wet and horrible but instead rang with musical clarity that pressed against awareness like the first note of a symphony. The limb came free from her shoulder without blood, without trauma, without any indication that what she had just done should have been impossible.

The arm shone with multicolored light that exceeded what mere Proterozoic transformation should have permitted. It shifted and restructured in her grip, bone and flesh and authority all reorganizing into configurations that had nothing to do with humanoid anatomy.
It formed into aVihuela.
The instrument resembled a guitar from traditions that predated most current civilizations, a stringed device designed to produce melody through careful manipulation.

But this Vihuela was composed of prismatic blue gold Proterozoic Bones arranged in configurations that declared it to be weapon as much as instrument. The body curved with elegance. The neck extended with precision that permitted no flaw. The strings stretched across that transformed material gloriously.

Where her left arm had been, an illusory hand formed from authority alone. The construct shimmered with the same blue gold brilliance that now defined her transformed limb, a replacement that functioned despite having no physical substance to support its existence.
Naldine held the Vihuela with the familiarity of someone who had wielded this instrument across eons of conflict.
Her right hand began to pluck the strings.
DING!

The first note rang out across the destroyed battlefield with clarity that pressed against everything within range. The oppression from the enemies ahead, that combined authority of three Proterozoic Scale entities that had been pressing against Noah’s foundations since their arrival, lessened slightly.
DING!
The second note followed immediately, and the oppression lessened further.
DING! DING! DING!
Multiple bones within Naldine’s body began to light up as she played. Her skeletal structure became visible through her flesh as Proterozoic transformation declared itself throughout her form!
Her body became surrounded by melody that seemed to exist as physical force rather than mere sound, waves of authority emanating from each note she produced.

She looked calm and immense as she continued playing, her expression holding none of the cold assessment she had displayed before. This was something else. This was Naldine Manthon expressing capabilities she had not revealed until this moment demanded them.
"It has been a while since I saw you all."
Her voice emerged steady despite her fingers continuing to dance across the strings.
"I knew we would be on opposite sides eventually, but I did not expect it so soon."
She paused her playing for a single beat.
"Are the others okay? Is Aryana doing good?"
At such words, Grimvault shook his head.
Laughter emerged from that wolf skull helm again, but this laughter held nothing of the amusement that had colored his earlier recognition. This was cold and brutal.
"Oh, you fucking whore."
The words pressed against everything within range with venom.
"Aryana is dead. You leave people you have influenced behind and expect them to thrive? Your ideals killed her the day you left THE Wyld."
Oh.
The tone of the strings Naldine pulled shifted into something that ached.

Sad notes emerged from the Vihuela, melody that communicated grief without requiring words to express it. Her fingers continued moving across those strings, but the music they produced now spoke of loss. She nodded calmly at the news, her expression holding acceptance.
The environment began to swirl around them.

The multicolored rain of the Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity fell heavier, droplets that carried Noah’s authority responding to the melody Naldine was producing. Rivers of multicolored seas that had been reforming in the regions not yet destroyed by combat began to vibrate to the tune she was enacting, vast bodies of transformed water resonating with notes that pressed against reality itself.
Meanwhile, Noah looked at this whole exchange with eyes that shone sharply.

He wanted to ask the question that had been building since Grimvault spoke that unfamiliar term. Where and what the hell was THE Wyld? Based on context, it should be where all these Primordial Architects were emerging from one after another. Some location or domain or faction that connected Naldine to Grimvault and Sammarthiel and Vahrkosis, some shared history that explained why they recognized each other with familiarity.
THE Wyld.
Another piece of Observable Existence he had not known about!

chapters.title: Chapter 5076: Does Age Make You Sadistic?
paragraphs: Noah focused on Naldine briefly as he felt a discordant tune every time she played the strings of that radiant instrument forged from her own body.
With each note, he observed an invisible flutter of hundreds of sound-based Embodiments and Apophasis blooming naturally around her form. These were not constructs she was deliberately creating.

They were byproducts, secondary effects that emerged from her playing without conscious direction. The alterations to surrounding existence that Absolutes at THE First Scale had to focus intensely to achieve were merely residual phenomena for those at THE Second Scale.
What they could accomplish when they actually tried was obscene.

And with their access to Infinity, what they could alter existence to become defied comprehension. Not to mention the weapons that each of the three enemies before them held. Each weapon was a completed Axiom or half completed Axiom, relics that should have bloomed from THE First Cause itself.
By all means, everything here was stacked against him, but...
Noah was ready to face it all.

He floated forward, golden flames of Observable force burning around his form as he moved past Naldine and THE Primordial Paradox. His small figure approached the three monstrous entities arrayed before them. He addressed Naldine without looking back.
"I will take on the big guy. You and Paradox here can worry about the tiny, lesser things behind him."
HUUM!
His words boomed across the destroyed battlefield with confidence!

Grimvault smiled brutally beneath that wolf skull helm, those pale fires in empty eye sockets flickering with amusement that seemed almost appreciative. Behind him, Vahrkosis and Sammarthiel frowned coldly at being designated as tiny and lesser things.
The serpentine mass’s forty-seven arms tightened their grips on weapons and artifacts. The elegant figure’s wings of swords spread wider.
Naldine looked at Noah calmly as her fingers continued dancing across the strings of her Vihuela.
A heavy melody of power emerged from the instrument, notes that pressed against reality with force that made the air itself thicken.
"He is too powerful for you."
Her voice emerged as she continued producing.
"A Calymmian Proterozoic Scale being. You cannot stand against him. I will face him."
Noah gazed forth coldly and tyrannically at the three enemies before them.

His eyes held none of the concern Naldine’s warning should have provoked. He observed Grimvault’s massive form, that blackened silver armor fused with flesh, that wolf skull helm blazing with pale fire, that greatsword drinking light from everything within range. He observed all of it and found himself unimpressed by what observation revealed!
This was merely a Bounded Lifeform like him!
"Nah, I got him."
His voice emerged with certainty that refused to acknowledge the gap between their Scales.
"I know...all about Grimvault here."

As he spoke those words, golden bubbles of light continued flowing from Grimvault’s armored form toward Noah’s position. THE Hadean Existential Singularities drifted through the space separating them with lazy purpose that belied their significance, each bubble containing concentrated essence of another being’s existence. They had been flowing since Noah designated Grimvault as his third target, and they continued flowing now with volume that increased as the distance between them decreased.
The bubbles disappeared into his body upon contact.

Noah digested all the new information as it flooded into his awareness.

THE Wyld. THE Deliverance. A closed ecosystem of Primordial Architects operating under authority that unmade disobedience without transition. Grimvault had tortured and consumed twelve of his own kind on orders that permitted quick elimination but did not require it!
He had chosen cruelty when efficiency would have sufficed. He had stretched moments into spans of agony for no purpose beyond personal satisfaction just like Beowulf.
And he had done it to someone Naldine cared about.

Noah floated ever closer toward Grimvault, his small form approaching that massive armored entity. The golden flames of Observable force burning around him intensified with each meter of distance closed, his presence pressing against Grimvault’s authority with defiance that should not have been possible from someone at THE First Scale.
"Why are so many of you Primordial Architects sadistic and cruel?"
His voice emerged with genuine curiosity wrapped in condemnation.
"Does living for too long naturally make you like so?"
He paused, his eyes meeting the pale fires burning in Grimvault’s empty sockets.
"You did not have to torture poor Aryana like that, Grimvault. Especially when THE Deliverance just ordered you to do a quick cleansing of opposition Primordial Architects."
BOOM!
His words landed across the destroyed battlefield with impact.

Grimvault looked over to Noah heavily, those pale fires in his wolf skull helm freezing entirely for an instant that seemed to stretch toward infinity. The brutal amusement that had colored his expression since arriving vanished, replaced by something that might have been shock if beings at his Scale were still capable of being shocked.
Naldine’s eyes became sharp as she observed the same thing.

Her fingers paused on the strings of her Vihuela, the melody she had been producing faltering for the first time since she began playing. Her singularity-dotted gaze fixed upon Noah with intensity that demanded explanation.
Both of their eyes asked the same question.
How the hell did he know about the things he just spoke of?

chapters.title: Chapter 5077: The Silurian Light I
paragraphs: Grimvault looked at Noah coldly.

The pale fires burning in that wolf skull helm had ceased their flickering, holding steady with intensity. Whatever shock Noah’s words had provoked, the Primordial Architect had processed it and moved beyond. Ancient beings did not linger on surprises. They adapted and continued.
"We have always known the one who bears Infinity so freely is capable."
His deep voice pressed against everything within range with authority that made the air itself thicken.
"You being able to perceive information like this is certainly unique."
Those pale fires studied Noah’s form.
"Are you similar to that other anomaly, Erwin? We have also grasped him to have something to do with information."
Noah’s eyes shone sharply at those words.
They had found out about Erwin as THE Information Paradox?

Grimvault held his Axiom weapon loosely in one massive gauntlet, that greatsword of light-drinking metal resting against the destroyed air as if it weighed nothing despite its colossal size. He smiled brutally beneath that wolf skull helm before nodding toward Naldine with acknowledgment that held mockery beneath its apparent respect.
"Do you know why THE Whorish Naldine does not wish for you to fight me?"
The designation made Naldine’s fingers pause on her strings for a fraction of an instant.
"Apart from the obvious discrepancy in power you may potentially be able to make up with Infinity ever so briefly."
He stepped forward, his massive armored form moving with grace that contradicted its size.

"The reason is the power that true Proterozoic Scale entities hold. Not those merely at Rhyacian, scratching at the surface of what advancement actually means. You see, once you continue up this Scale of Existence enough, grasp some tidbits of Infinity and the force of nature that is Observable, have a decent number of Proterozoic Bones, and you begin to truly become in tune with existence itself, you can begin to grasp something greater."
His pale fires burned brighter as he spoke.
"THE Pulse of The Scales."
BOOM!

Grimvault raised his arms upward as if he were a priest distilling grand knowledge to congregations that had gathered to receive wisdom from mouths they could not comprehend. His blackened silver armor caught the multicolored light of the surrounding storm, that fused flesh and metal seeming almost beautiful in the illumination despite the horror of its composition.

"Capabilities that distinguish you from all other lesser things," he continued with voice that pressed against reality with force that made the suspended rain droplets tremble. "Pulses that only those who have achieved true distinction within THE Second Scale can perceive, let alone utilize. There are many such Pulses scattered across the methodologies of Proterozoic advancement, scattered across Existence...but one stands above most others in its significance."
His wolf skull helm tilted slightly.
"One Pulse that nearly every knowledgeable Proterozoic Scale entity seeks to learn is known to us as THE Silurian Light."
The words landed with impact!

"Named after THE Silurian Cause, a fiery type of First Cause capable of forming an Observable Existence in its entirety. Even I do not understand the true intricacies of what THE Silurian Cause actually is or was. Some believe it predates THE First Cause that formed our Observable Existence. Others believe it exists parallel to all First Causes, a template from which creation itself learned how to create."
He lowered his arms slowly.
"What matters is that those who grasp THE Pulse of The Scales deeply enough can learn to channel a fraction of that primordial fire. A fraction that, when applied correctly, does not merely kill."
His pale fires seemed to dim as he spoke the next words.
"It erases."

"THE Silurian Light does not simply end an existence," Grimvault continued, his voice taking on the cadence of one who had delivered this explanation before, who had watched the faces of those he explained it to shift from confusion to horror to despair. "It unravels causality itself. When someone is consumed by this Pulse, their entire causality within the weavings of existence is pulled free, and everything that causality touched comes undone."
He began pacing slowly before them, that massive armored form moving with deliberation as if he was savoring this moment.

"Consider what that means. Every action the erased being ever took ceases to have occurred. Every choice they made unmakes itself. Every consequence that flowed from their existence reverberates backward through time and probability, collapsing into configurations that exclude their participation entirely."
His wolf skull helm oriented toward Noah directly.

"If you were to kill someone, and then I were to erase you with THE Silurian Light, that death would reverse. The being you killed would simply exist again, their murder having never occurred because the murderer was unraveled from the causality that permitted the act. Their wounds would close. Their breath would return. Their existence would resume as if your blade had never fallen."
"So Beowulf here...you could kill and collapse him now. But after I erase you, that action would be invalidated as even without doing anything more, Beowulf would return afterwards."
The implications pressed against Noah’s awareness.

"The proficiency with which one wields THE Silurian Light determines the scope of this unraveling," Grimvault explained further, his voice carrying pride that seemed almost scholarly despite the subject matter. "Those who have only begun to grasp this Pulse can erase beings and undo perhaps minutes of their actions. The immediate consequences reverse, but deeper causalities remain intact."
He held up one gauntleted hand.

"Those who have cultivated greater proficiency can undo months and years of accumulated action. Entire campaigns of warfare unmade. Alliances that took years to forge simply never forming because the one who forged them was erased before the thought occurred to them."
A second gauntleted hand rose.

"And those who have truly mastered THE Silurian Light, who have made this Pulse an extension of their Civilization itself, can enact truly extensive Retroactive Reversal. Years of accumulated causality unraveled. Perhaps millions and billions. Perhaps more, depending on the significance of the erased existence and the power of the one doing the erasing."
