chapters.title: Chapter 5078: The Silurian Light II
paragraphs: His arms spread wide.

"But even that is not the full extent of what this Pulse permits. With sufficient power and precision, one can target not merely actions but the Civilization that enabled those actions. Everything that Civilization stood for, every principle it embodied, every change it wrought upon existence through its expression, all of it can be unmade. The framework that supported a being’s power collapses, and everything built upon that framework collapses with it."
His voice dropped lower.
"And if one is killed thoroughly enough with THE Silurian Light, if the erasure is complete and absolute, then something even more terrible occurs."
He paused for effect that seemed almost theatrical.

"Your entire existence becomes forgotten. Those who knew you find that they cannot recall your face. Those who loved you discover that love directed toward emptiness they cannot explain. Those who hated you find their hatred dissolved into confusion about what, exactly, they were hating."
His pale fires burned with intensity that exceeded anything they had displayed before.

"Only the one who erased you remembers. Only the wielder of THE Silurian Light retains knowledge of what was unmade. They become the sole repository of your existence, the only being in all of Observable Existence who knows that you ever were."
He smiled beneath that wolf skull helm.

"That is the power that true Proterozoic Scale entities can wield. That is why your Naldine does not wish for you to face me. Not because I might kill you. Because I might erase you so thoroughly that even your precious Infinity cannot recall what it once flowed through."
BOOM!
After Grimvault finished echoing out such terrifying words, Noah and THE Primordial Paradox looked over with somber eyes.

Naldine grasped her instrument tightly, her fingers pressing against strings that had ceased producing sound. Her expression declared that everything Grimvault had described was true, that this was not intimidation but simple statement of capability he possessed and would use without hesitation.
Noah processed the implications with the enhanced clarity THE Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation from Ozymandias provided.

Everything he had done erased. The Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity reversed, those transformed seas and falling rains simply ceasing to exist because the one who created them had been unraveled from causality. THE Infiniverse returned to whatever state it had occupied before he touched it, all those Civilizational advancements unmade, all those bodies he had cultivated dissolved into potential that had never been actualized.

His connection with Eon severed retroactively, that Quintessence Infiniforce bond never forming because he had never existed to place it within her. The Observable force flooding into him ceasing to flow because there was no him for it to flow into.
Eon...she should be capable of something like this, but she never threatened to do this. Why?
Many things would unfold!
Alexander still tortured and still broken.
THE Primordial Mycelia still alive, still spreading, still consuming everything it touched because the one who stopped it had been unmade before the stopping could occur.
Everything he had accomplished across his journey through Observable Existence simply gone, unraveled, forgotten by all except the one who held the fire that burned away causality itself.
It was a truly terrifying capability.
After the terrifying words of Grimvault, Noah gazed up at him fearlessly.

His expression held none of the concern that THE Silurian Light should have provoked. He had just been told that his entire existence could be unraveled, that everything he had accomplished across Observable Existence could be undone as if he had never existed to accomplish it. Yet his eyes remained steady, his posture remained composed, his presence continued pressing against Grimvault’s authority with defiance that refused to acknowledge the gap between their capabilities.

"So... theoretically, if you were burnt and collapsed with THE Silurian Light, even that Aryana I have never met and all others you collapsed before would return as if you never existed to do that in the first place?"
His reply was a ridiculous one.

Grimvault smiled brutally beneath that wolf skull helm, those pale fires flickering with amusement that seemed almost appreciative of the audacity being displayed before him. The question Noah had asked was not born from fear or desperation. It was calculation!
He looked between Noah and Naldine with gaze that held mockery beneath its apparent consideration.
"It is something you cannot defend against."
His deep voice pressed against everything within range.

"To do so, you would need another Pulse. As much as I would have no issue utilizing such a thing on you, there are still many unknowns and uncertainties about you. Unraveling you with THE Silurian Light could have many unexpected effects, with changes occurring throughout Observable Existence that even I cannot predict."
He paused, those pale fires dimming slightly.
"So I have caution within me. But it does not mean I will not throw this caution to the wind and do what I must if push comes to shove."
His wolf skull helm tilted forward.
"This is your last chance of Diplomacy. The one whose name you spoke of has not spoken of you just yet, and I would rather wait for directives before making permanent moves myself."
His smile widened beneath that helm as he spoke the final words with deliberate slowness that seemed designed to antagonize.
"What. Will. It. Be...Little Bundle..."
The mockery pressed against Noah’s awareness.
"Of."
Each word landing like a blow intended to provoke!
"Infinity?"
Little Bundle of Infinity!
Oh!

The final sentence was mocking and cruel, every syllable uttered slowly alongside Grimvault’s brutal smile. It was meant to antagonize, to remind Noah of what he was in the eyes of beings who had existed since before most current powers learned to crawl. A little bundle. A curiosity. Something to be studied and perhaps unmade if it proved too troublesome to preserve.
Off to the side, THE Primordial Paradox rolled up his nonexistent sleeves as he if was ready to throw down!
Who did this fucker think he was?!

The framework that supported a being’s power collapses, and everything built upon that framework collapses with it."
His voice dropped lower.
"And if one is killed thoroughly enough with THE Silurian Light, if the erasure is complete and absolute, then something even more terrible occurs."
He paused for effect that seemed almost theatrical.
"Your entire existence becomes forgotten.
Those who knew you find that they cannot recall your face.
Those who loved you discover that love directed toward emptiness they cannot explain.
Those who hated you find their hatred dissolved into confusion about what, exactly, they were hating."
His pale fires burned with intensity that exceeded anything they had displayed before.
"Only the one who erased you remembers.
Only the wielder of THE Silurian Light retains knowledge of what was unmade.
They become the sole repository of your existence, the only being in all of Observable Existence who knows that you ever were."
He smiled beneath that wolf skull helm.
"That is the power that true Proterozoic Scale entities can wield.
That is why your Naldine does not wish for you to face me.
Not because I might kill you.
Because I might erase you so thoroughly that even your precious Infinity cannot recall what it once flowed through."
BOOM!
After Grimvault finished echoing out such terrifying words, Noah and THE Primordial Paradox looked over with somber eyes.
Naldine grasped her instrument tightly, her fingers pressing against strings that had ceased producing sound.
Her expression declared that everything Grimvault had described was true, that this was not intimidation but simple statement of capability he possessed and would use without hesitation.
Noah processed the implications with the enhanced clarity THE Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation from Ozymandias provided.
Everything he had done erased.
The Pluvial Epoch of Existential Infinity reversed, those transformed seas and falling rains simply ceasing to exist because the one who created them had been unraveled from causality.

THE Infiniverse returned to whatever state it had occupied before he touched it, all those Civilizational advancements unmade, all those bodies he had cultivated dissolved into potential that had never been actualized.
His connection with Eon severed retroactively, that Quintessence Infiniforce bond never forming because he had never existed to place it within her.
The Observable force flooding into him ceasing to flow because there was no him for it to flow into.
Eon...she should be capable of something like this, but she never threatened to do this.
Why?
Many things would unfold!
Alexander still tortured and still broken.
THE Primordial Mycelia still alive, still spreading, still consuming everything it touched because the one who stopped it had been unmade before the stopping could occur.
Everything he had accomplished across his journey through Observable Existence simply gone, unraveled, forgotten by all except the one who held the fire that burned away causality itself.
It was a truly terrifying capability.
After the terrifying words of Grimvault, Noah gazed up at him fearlessly.
His expression held none of the concern that THE Silurian Light should have provoked.
He had just been told that his entire existence could be unraveled, that everything he had accomplished across Observable Existence could be undone as if he had never existed to accomplish it.

Yet his eyes remained steady, his posture remained composed, his presence continued pressing against Grimvault’s authority with defiance that refused to acknowledge the gap between their capabilities.

"So... theoretically, if you were burnt and collapsed with THE Silurian Light, even that Aryana I have never met and all others you collapsed before would return as if you never existed to do that in the first place?"
His reply was a ridiculous one.
Grimvault smiled brutally beneath that wolf skull helm, those pale fires flickering with amusement that seemed almost appreciative of the audacity being displayed before him.
The question Noah had asked was not born from fear or desperation.
It was calculation!
He looked between Noah and Naldine with gaze that held mockery beneath its apparent consideration.
"It is something you cannot defend against."
His deep voice pressed against everything within range.
"To do so, you would need another Pulse.
As much as I would have no issue utilizing such a thing on you, there are still many unknowns and uncertainties about you.
Unraveling you with THE Silurian Light could have many unexpected effects, with changes occurring throughout Observable Existence that even I cannot predict."
He paused, those pale fires dimming slightly.
"So I have caution within me.
But it does not mean I will not throw this caution to the wind and do what I must if push comes to shove."
His wolf skull helm tilted forward.
"This is your last chance of Diplomacy.
The one whose name you spoke of has not spoken of you just yet, and I would rather wait for directives before making permanent moves myself."
His smile widened beneath that helm as he spoke the final words with deliberate slowness that seemed designed to antagonize.
"What.
Will.
It.
Be...Little Bundle..."
The mockery pressed against Noah’s awareness.
"Of."
Each word landing like a blow intended to provoke!
"Infinity?"
Little Bundle of Infinity!
Oh!
The final sentence was mocking and cruel, every syllable uttered slowly alongside Grimvault’s brutal smile.
It was meant to antagonize, to remind Noah of what he was in the eyes of beings who had existed since before most current powers learned to crawl.
A little bundle.
A curiosity.
Something to be studied and perhaps unmade if it proved too troublesome to preserve.
Off to the side, THE Primordial Paradox rolled up his nonexistent sleeves as he if was ready to throw down!
Who did this fucker think he was?!

chapters.title: Chapter 5079: The Silurian Light III
paragraphs: And at such a time, Noah actually turned his gaze behind him.
He locked eyes with Naldine, observing her expression shift. Her fingers remained poised over the strings of her Vihuela. Her singularity-dotted eyes held intensity that demanded he choose wisely.
"The next few seconds are going to be very critical ones."
HUUM!
His calm words were an answer, though not the answer anyone present had expected.

He could have chosen to say many things. He could have accepted the diplomacy Grimvault offered, could have released Beowulf and retreated to fight another day, could have recognized that three Proterozoic Scale entities including one at the Calymmian Tier represented a threat he could not overcome regardless of his Infinity.
He chose none of those options.
Behind him, a shimmering golden crack of existence bloomed into being.

The crack appeared in the fabric of reality itself, multicolored light bleeding through the fracture. Massive hands appeared at the edges of that crack, fingers the size of buildings grasping the boundaries of the opening. Those hands tore the crack wide, ripping existence apart to create space sufficient for what was coming through.
|THE Hadean Organ of Civilization: External release activated.|
|Entity: Ozymandias.|
|Source: THE Hadean Desmoterion.|
|Status: Emerging into Observable Existence.|
An utter wonder stepped out.

Ozymandias emerged from the golden crack with presence that pressed against everything within range. His form was titanic, a humanoid configuration of muscle and authority that dwarfed even Grimvault’s massive armored frame. His skin held the same complexion as Noah’s, stretched over musculature that had been cultivated across Civilizational Eons of Development. His features bore resemblance to Noah’s own, the same bone structure, the same set of the jaw, the same shape of the eyes, though scaled to proportions that made the similarity somewhat unsettling.
He floated inches away from Noah’s body, their two faces being somewhat alike in ways that declared their connection without requiring explanation.
|Entity Released: Ozymandias.|
|Classification: THE Hadean Avatar.|
|Current Scale: THE Proterozoic Scale - Rhyacian Tier.|
|Proterozoic Bones: THE Hadean Limb of Infinite Hunger (right leg, complete). THE Hadean Arm of Infinite Reach (right arm, complete). THE Hadean Skull of Infinite Perception (skull, complete).|
|Proterozoic Organ: THE Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation (brain, complete).|
|Active Duration Outside THE Hadean Desmoterion: 81 seconds.|
|Note: Duration increased from 9 seconds due to influx of Observable force from Gilded Existence. Connection to THE Secretive Eon has enhanced all Hadean parameters.|
The aura of a thick and heavy Second Scale permeated across the body of Ozymandias.

It pressed against everything within range with authority that declared his classification to all who could perceive it. His Proterozoic Bones radiated light that shone through his flesh, his right leg blazing gold, his right arm matching that brilliance, his skull illuminating from within with intensity that painted nearby space in hues of multicolored authority. And beyond those bones, his Proterozoic Organ pulsed with power that exceeded what most Second Scale entities possessed.

THE Primordial Paradox observed this emergence with expression that shifted through shock into assessment. His obsidian titanic form, which had seemed massive beside Noah’s humanoid body, now stood comparable to Ozymandias’s frame. Another Second Scale entity had just appeared on their side of this confrontation!

Naldine’s fingers paused on her strings as she processed what she was witnessing. Her singularity-dotted eyes widened slightly before returning to their normal configuration. She had known Noah possessed capabilities beyond what he displayed, but this was beyond what she had anticipated. He had been concealing a Second Scale entity within his existence!

Behind them, Beowulf’s screams paused for an instant as even that tortured Primordial Architect perceived the shift in the battlefield’s dynamics. Alexander continued his work, but his eyes flickered toward the newly emerged titan.

Grimvault, Sammarthiel, and Vahrkosis observed Ozymandias with coldness. Three Scale 2s against two had become three against three, with one of the new arrivals radiating Proterozoic authority that declared him a genuine threat.
Noah’s eyes were unfathomably bright at this time.

The muscular visage of Ozymandias roared grandly toward Grimvault, that titan’s voice emerging with force that pressed against the destroyed battlefield with a challenge that could not be ignored. His massive chest expanded as he drew breath that should not have been necessary for a being at his classification, and then he released everything he had been containing.
His head illuminated with terrifying light.

THE Hadean Skull of Infinite Perception blazed with multicolored brilliance that pressed outward from Ozymandias’s form in expanding waves. The light washed over everything within range, painting Grimvault and his companions, painting Naldine and THE Primordial Paradox, painting the destroyed battlefield and the suspended rain and the screaming figure of Beowulf.
And then something impossible occurred.
|Proterozoic Organ Activation: THE Hadean Mind of Infinite Calculation.|
|Ability: Infinite Temporal Perception.|

|Effect: User’s perception of time becomes infinitely malleable. Instants can be stretched to feel like days, months, or years according to user’s will. This is perception only and does not affect external reality. Others continue to move at normal speed while user experiences expanded awareness.|
|Duration: Determined by user. Can be maintained indefinitely within active period outside THE Hadean Desmoterion.|
|Note: This ability affects Noah Osmont through connection to Ozymandias. Both entities share expanded perception while ability is active.|
|Current Perception State: One instant stretched toward infinity.|
Everything seemed to freeze!

Grimvault’s brutal smile remained fixed in place, those pale fires in his wolf skull helm suspended mid-flicker. Sammarthiel’s wings of swords hung motionless, thousands of blades neither rising nor falling. Vahrkosis’s serpentine coils had ceased their undulation, forty-seven arms frozen in positions that suggested readiness for violence that would not arrive until perception returned to normal speed.
The multicolored rain hung suspended in the air around them!
The screams of Beowulf had paused mid-sound, that note of agony stretched into silence that would resume when infinity concluded!
Noah observed this frozen landscape, this moment stretched beyond what moments were designed to contain. He sighed with breath that felt like it could last for centuries if he wished it to.

In his perception, he had days or months if he wished in this span of an infinity. Even though he did not freeze anyone or anything, even though external reality continued at its normal pace, he could experience this single instant as an eternity of contemplation.
But such a space was not meant for rest.
"Hey."
His voice emerged within this stretched moment, audible only to himself and those he chose to include.
"You say you are here to be by my side and help me so that the Splintering of Observable Existence does not occur, but why keep such good material like THE Pulse of The Scales away from me?"
